blocks.original_text:
- name: int_hubspot__contact_lifecycle_metrics
      schema: intermediate
      description: Contact-level lifecycle, email engagement, deal association, and composite engagement scoring
      grain: One row per contact_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust (contact_id, email, created_date, first_conversion_date)
      - raw.email_event_data (recipient, type, created)
      - raw.deal_contact_data (contact_id, deal_id)
      - raw.deal_data (deal_id, property_createdate, property_closedate, property_amount)
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust as the contact universe (one row per contact_id). - Lifecycle metrics: - contact_age_days = whole days from created_date to today. - days_to_conversion = whole days from created_date to first_conversion_date; if never converted, use today. - contact_maturity_segment by age: <30 days = "New Contact"; <90 = "Recent Contact"; <365 = "Established Contact"; otherwise "Mature Contact". - conversion_status = "Converted" if first_conversion_date exists, else "Not Converted". - conversion_velocity_score: if no conversion → 0; else map days-to-first-conversion: ≤1→100; ≤7→80; ≤30→60; ≤90→40; otherwise→20. - Email engagement (left join on email = recipient): - Count events per contact_id: SENT, OPEN, CLICK, BOUNCE (one per matching row); if no matches, counts are 0. - email_open_rate = (OPEN ÷ SENT) × 100 if SENT > 0, else 0; email_click_through_rate = (CLICK ÷ OPEN) × 100 if OPEN > 0, else 0; rates are not rounded or capped and can exceed 100. - last_engagement_date = latest timestamp of OPEN or CLICK events, parsing created from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - Deal association (left join deal_contact_data on contact_id, then deal_data on deal_id): - total_associated_deals = distinct count of linked deals. - total_closed_deals = distinct count of linked deals with a close date. - total_deal_value = sum of amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; 0 if none. - avg_deal_value = average amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; NULL if no closed deals. - first_deal_date = earliest deal create timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - last_deal_closed_date = latest deal close timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - overall_engagement_score (no rounding): - 0.3 × conversion_velocity_score - + if total_emails_sent > 0 then min(email_open_rate × 0.4, 40) else 0 - + if email_open_rate > 0 then min(email_click_through_rate × 0.2, 20) else 0 - + if total_associated_deals > 0 then min(total_associated_deals × 5, 10) else 0 - engagement_tier: "High Engagement" if score ≥ 80; "Medium Engagement" if score ≥ 50; otherwise "Low Engagement". - All joins are left joins from the contact universe; counts and sums default to 0 where specified; averages may be NULL if no qualifying rows; timestamps are parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS".'
      columns:
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique contact identifier; exactly one row per contact_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact email used to join to email events by exact match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Contact creation timestamp used as the lifecycle anchor; no timezone adjustments applied
      - name: first_conversion_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First recorded conversion timestamp if present; NULL if never converted
      - name: contact_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from created_date to today at query time
      - name: days_to_conversion
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from created_date to first_conversion_date; if never converted, to today; equals contact_age_days when not converted
      - name: contact_maturity_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Age band: <30 New; <90 Recent; <365 Established; otherwise Mature'
      - name: conversion_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Converted if first_conversion_date exists; otherwise Not Converted
      - name: conversion_velocity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Days-to-first-conversion score: no conversion→0; ≤1→100; ≤7→80; ≤30→60; ≤90→40; otherwise→20'
      - name: total_emails_sent
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email events with type SENT matched by email; duplicates preserved; 0 if none
      - name: total_emails_opened
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email events with type OPEN matched by email; duplicates preserved; 0 if none
      - name: total_emails_clicked
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email events with type CLICK matched by email; duplicates preserved; 0 if none
      - name: total_emails_bounced
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of email events with type BOUNCE matched by email; duplicates preserved; 0 if none
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: OPEN ÷ SENT × 100 if SENT > 0, else 0; not rounded or capped and may exceed 100
      - name: email_click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: CLICK ÷ OPEN × 100 if OPEN > 0, else 0; not rounded or capped and may exceed 100
      - name: last_engagement_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest OPEN or CLICK event timestamp parsed from 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; NULL if none
      - name: total_associated_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deals linked to the contact; 0 if none
      - name: total_closed_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of associated deals with a close date; 0 if none
      - name: total_deal_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of amounts over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; 0 if none
      - name: avg_deal_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; NULL if no closed deals
      - name: first_deal_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest associated deal create timestamp parsed from 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; NULL if none
      - name: last_deal_closed_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest associated deal close timestamp parsed from 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; NULL if none
      - name: overall_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Composite score: 0.3×velocity + min(open rate×0.4, 40) if sent>0 + min(CTR×0.2, 20) if open_rate>0 + min(deals×5, 10) if deals>0; no rounding'
      - name: engagement_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High Engagement if score ≥ 80; Medium Engagement if ≥ 50; otherwise Low Engagement

output.equality_policy: exact CAST AS VARCHAR per row; no trim/case/numeric/date normalization; both NULL ignored; at least one nonnull equal row; one-sided NULL differs

alternatives.expression_sql: CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT)
CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), COALESCE(CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE)) AS BIGINT)

CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 30 THEN 'New Contact' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 90 THEN 'Recent Contact' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) < 365 THEN 'Established Contact' ELSE 'Mature Contact' END
CASE WHEN NOT c.first_conversion_date IS NULL THEN 'Converted' ELSE 'Not Converted' END

CAST(CASE WHEN c.first_conversion_date IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE)) <= 1 THEN 100 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE)) <= 7 THEN 80 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE)) <= 30 THEN 60 WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(c.created_date AS DATE), CAST(c.first_conversion_date AS DATE)) <= 90 THEN 40 ELSE 20 END AS INT)
CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.total_emails_sent, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(e.total_emails_opened AS DOUBLE) / e.total_emails_sent * 100 ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.total_emails_opened, 0) > 0 THEN CAST(e.total_emails_clicked AS DOUBLE) / e.total_emails_opened * 100 ELSE 0 END

0.3 * conversion_velocity_score + CASE WHEN total_emails_sent > 0 THEN LEAST(email_open_rate * 0.4, 40) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN email_open_rate > 0 THEN LEAST(email_click_through_rate * 0.2, 20) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN total_associated_deals > 0 THEN LEAST(total_associated_deals * 5, 10) ELSE 0 END
CASE WHEN overall_engagement_score >= 80 THEN 'High Engagement' WHEN overall_engagement_score >= 50 THEN 'Medium Engagement' ELSE 'Low Engagement' END

runtime_hits.line_text: with c as (select * from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust), email_metrics as (select c.contact_id, count(*) filter(where e.type='SENT') as total_emails_sent, count(*) filter(where e.type='OPEN') as total_emails_opened, count(*) filter(where e.type='CLICK') as total_emails_clicked, count(*) filter(where e.type='BOUNCE') as total_emails_bounced, max(try_strptime(substr(e.created,1,19),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')) filter(where e.type in ('OPEN','CLICK')) as last_engagement_date from c left join raw.email_event_data e on c.email=e.recipient group by c.contact_id), deal_metrics as (select dc.contact_id, count(distinct d.deal_id) as total_associated_deals, count(distinct d.deal_id) filter(where d.property_closedate is not null) as references.name: intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust as the contact universe (one row per contact_id). - Lifecycle metrics: - contact_age_days = whole days from created_date to today. - days_to_conversion = whole days from created_date to first_conversion_date; if never converted, use today. - contact_maturity_segment by age: <30 days = "New Contact"; <90 = "Recent Contact"; <365 = "Established Contact"; otherwise "Mature Contact". - conversion_status = "Converted" if first_conversion_date exists, else "Not Converted". - conversion_velocity_score: if no conversion → 0; else map days-to-first-conversion: ≤1→100; ≤7→80; ≤30→60; ≤90→40; otherwise→20. - Email engagement (left join on email = recipient): - Count events per contact_id: SENT, OPEN, CLICK, BOUNCE (one per matching row); if no matches, counts are 0. - email_open_rate = (OPEN ÷ SENT) × 100 if SENT > 0, else 0; email_click_through_rate = (CLICK ÷ OPEN) × 100 if OPEN > 0, else 0; rates are not rounded or capped and can exceed 100. - last_engagement_date = latest timestamp of OPEN or CLICK events, parsing created from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - Deal association (left join deal_contact_data on contact_id, then deal_data on deal_id): - total_associated_deals = distinct count of linked deals. - total_closed_deals = distinct count of linked deals with a close date. - total_deal_value = sum of amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; 0 if none. - avg_deal_value = average amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; NULL if no closed deals. - first_deal_date = earliest deal create timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - last_deal_closed_date = latest deal close timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - overall_engagement_score (no rounding): - 0.3 × conversion_velocity_score - + if total_emails_sent > 0 then min(email_open_rate × 0.4, 40) else 0 - + if email_open_rate > 0 then min(email_click_through_rate × 0.2, 20) else 0 - + if total_associated_deals > 0 then min(total_associated_deals × 5, 10) else 0 - engagement_tier: "High Engagement" if score ≥ 80; "Medium Engagement" if score ≥ 50; otherwise "Low Engagement". - All joins are left joins from the contact universe; counts and sums default to 0 where specified; averages may be NULL if no qualifying rows; timestamps are parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS".'

business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust as the contact universe (one row per contact_id). - Lifecycle metrics: - contact_age_days = whole days from created_date to today. - days_to_conversion = whole days from created_date to first_conversion_date; if never converted, use today. - contact_maturity_segment by age: <30 days = "New Contact"; <90 = "Recent Contact"; <365 = "Established Contact"; otherwise "Mature Contact". - conversion_status = "Converted" if first_conversion_date exists, else "Not Converted". - conversion_velocity_score: if no conversion → 0; else map days-to-first-conversion: ≤1→100; ≤7→80; ≤30→60; ≤90→40; otherwise→20. - Email engagement (left join on email = recipient): - Count events per contact_id: SENT, OPEN, CLICK, BOUNCE (one per matching row); if no matches, counts are 0. - email_open_rate = (OPEN ÷ SENT) × 100 if SENT > 0, else 0; email_click_through_rate = (CLICK ÷ OPEN) × 100 if OPEN > 0, else 0; rates are not rounded or capped and can exceed 100. - last_engagement_date = latest timestamp of OPEN or CLICK events, parsing created from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - Deal association (left join deal_contact_data on contact_id, then deal_data on deal_id): - total_associated_deals = distinct count of linked deals. - total_closed_deals = distinct count of linked deals with a close date. - total_deal_value = sum of amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; 0 if none. - avg_deal_value = average amount over closed deals, treating missing amounts as 0; NULL if no closed deals. - first_deal_date = earliest deal create timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - last_deal_closed_date = latest deal close timestamp parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"; NULL if none. - overall_engagement_score (no rounding): - 0.3 × conversion_velocity_score - + if total_emails_sent > 0 then min(email_open_rate × 0.4, 40) else 0 - + if email_open_rate > 0 then min(email_click_through_rate × 0.2, 20) else 0 - + if total_associated_deals > 0 then min(total_associated_deals × 5, 10) else 0 - engagement_tier: "High Engagement" if score ≥ 80; "Medium Engagement" if score ≥ 50; otherwise "Low Engagement". - All joins are left joins from the contact universe; counts and sums default to 0 where specified; averages may be NULL if no qualifying rows; timestamps are parsed from "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS".'

- name: int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics
      schema: intermediate
      description: Deal-level metrics enriched with pipeline stage aggregates and created-quarter trends; one row per deal with stage and quarterly performance.
      grain: One row per deal_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced
      business_logic: '- Build base from intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced: - Select deal, pipeline, owner, and timestamp fields; rename amount to deal_amount and closed_date to close_date. - deal_cycle_time_days: number of whole days from created_date to close_date when both exist; otherwise NULL. - deal_status: - Won: closed_date present and amount > 0 - Lost: closed_date present and amount = 0 - Open: closed_date absent - Unknown: any other case (e.g., closed with negative or NULL amount) - deal_size_category: - Enterprise (100K+): amount >= 100000 - Large (50K-100K): 50000–<100000 - Medium (10K-50K): 10000–<50000 - Small (<10K): >0–<10000 - No Value: amount <= 0 or NULL - created_year/created_quarter are extracted from created_date; closed_year/closed_quarter are extracted only when close_date exists. - Compute pipeline_stage_analysis grouped by (deal_pipeline, deal_pipeline_stage), excluding NULL stage IDs: - deals_in_stage: number of deals in the group. - won_from_stage / lost_from_stage: counts where status is Won / Lost. - stage_win_rate: percentage of group deals that are Won (0–100); 0 when the denominator would be zero. - total_stage_value: sum of deal_amount; averages computed over non-NULL amounts. - avg_stage_cycle_time: average cycle time for Won deals only. - median_stage_cycle_time: continuous median (50th percentile) of non-NULL cycle times in the group. - Compute quarterly_performance_trends grouped by (created_year, created_quarter), including only rows with both present: - quarterly_deals_created: number of deals created in the cohort. - quarterly_deal_value_created: sum of deal_amount (NULL if all amounts are NULL). - same_quarter_wins: count of deals that were created and closed Won in the same year-quarter. - same_quarter_revenue: sum of deal_amount for those same-quarter Wins (0 when none in the cohort). - same_quarter_conversion_rate: percentage of cohort deals that closed Won in the same quarter (0–100); 0 when the cohort size is zero. - Left join stage metrics on (deal_pipeline, deal_pipeline_stage) and quarterly metrics on (created_year, created_quarter). - If a join has no match (e.g., stage ID or created_date is NULL), all joined metrics from that source are NULL. - Output one row per deal_id with base fields plus matched stage and quarterly metrics; percentages are 0–100 with no rounding; standard aggregates ignore NULL inputs.'
      columns:
      - name: deal_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique deal identifier; exactly one output row per deal_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: deal_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deal name from source; may be NULL.
      - name: deal_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Deal monetary amount from source; used in stage and quarterly aggregates; NULLs are ignored by aggregates.
      - name: deal_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline stage label from source; may be NULL; aggregations use the stage ID.
      - name: deal_pipeline
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline label from source; used with stage ID to join stage-level aggregates; may be NULL.
      - name: deal_pipeline_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline stage ID; groups and joins stage-level aggregates; NULL excludes the deal from stage metrics.
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner identifier from source; may be NULL.
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Deal creation timestamp; drives created_year/quarter and quarterly joins; may be NULL.
      - name: close_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Deal closed timestamp; may be NULL; used in cycle time and status.
      - name: deal_cycle_time_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days between created_date and close_date; NULL if either date is NULL.
      - name: deal_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Won (closed and amount > 0), Lost (closed and amount = 0), Open (not closed), or Unknown otherwise.
      - name: deal_size_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Enterprise (>=100000), Large (>=50000 and <100000), Medium (>=10000 and <50000), Small (>0 and <10000), or No Value (<=0 or NULL).
      - name: created_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year extracted from created_date; NULL when created_date is NULL.
      - name: created_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Quarter number (1–4) extracted from created_date; NULL when created_date is NULL.
      - name: closed_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year extracted from close_date when present; else NULL.
      - name: closed_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Quarter number (1–4) extracted from close_date when present; else NULL.
      - name: deals_in_stage
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals in the joined (deal_pipeline, deal_pipeline_stage) group; NULL when no stage match.
      - name: won_from_stage
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of Won deals in the joined stage group; NULL when no stage match.
      - name: lost_from_stage
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of Lost deals in the joined stage group; NULL when no stage match.
      - name: stage_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of stage deals that are Won (0–100); 0 when the denominator would be zero; NULL when no stage match.
      - name: total_stage_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount across the joined stage group; NULL when no stage match or all amounts are NULL.
      - name: avg_stage_deal_size
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average deal_amount across the joined stage group; NULL when no stage match or no non-NULL amounts.
      - name: avg_stage_cycle_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average cycle time (days) for Won deals in the joined stage group; NULL when none or no stage match.
      - name: median_stage_cycle_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Continuous median (50th percentile) of non-NULL cycle times in the joined stage group; NULL when none or no stage match.
      - name: quarterly_deals_created
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals created in the deal's (created_year, created_quarter); NULL when no quarterly match.
      - name: quarterly_deal_value_created
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for deals created in the deal's quarter; NULL when no quarterly match or all amounts are NULL.
      - name: same_quarter_wins
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of deals that were created and closed Won in the same year-quarter; NULL when no quarterly match.
      - name: same_quarter_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for same-quarter Won deals in the created cohort; 0 when none in the cohort; NULL when no quarterly match.
      - name: same_quarter_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of deals created in the quarter that closed Won in the same quarter (0–100); 0 when cohort size is zero; NULL when no quarterly match.

- name: int_hubspot__deals_enhanced
      schema: intermediate
      description: Deals enriched with pipeline, stage, and owner details via left joins; no filtering or aggregation
      grain: One row per stg_hubspot__deal record; rows may multiply if joined tables have multiple matches
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_hubspot__deal
      - staging.stg_hubspot__deal_pipeline
      - staging.stg_hubspot__deal_pipeline_stage
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__owners_enhanced
      business_logic: '- Start with all columns from staging.stg_hubspot__deal (no filtering or deduplication). - Left join staging.stg_hubspot__deal_pipeline on deal_pipeline_id to add: - pipeline_label, is_pipeline_active. - created_timestamp renamed to deal_pipeline_created_at; updated_timestamp renamed to deal_pipeline_updated_at. - is_deal_pipeline_deleted is set to false for all rows; if there is no matching pipeline, the flag remains false while other pipeline fields are NULL. - Left join staging.stg_hubspot__deal_pipeline_stage on deal_pipeline_stage_id to add: - pipeline_stage_label and is_deal_pipeline_stage_deleted, defaulting the deletion flag to false when missing or when there is no matching stage. - Left join intermediate.int_hubspot__owners_enhanced on owner_id to add owner_active_user_id, owner_email_address, and owner_full_name (NULL when no match). - All joins are LEFT JOINs; unmatched keys yield NULLs (or false where defaults are specified). - If any joined source has multiple rows per key, the output includes one row per match (no deduplication or tie-breaking).'
      columns:
      - name: deal_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary deal identifier from stg_hubspot__deal; duplicates (if present) are preserved; NULLs pass through
      - name: deal_pipeline_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline identifier from stg_hubspot__deal; used to left join pipeline attributes; NULLs pass through
      - name: deal_pipeline_stage_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline stage identifier from stg_hubspot__deal; used to left join stage attributes; NULLs pass through
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner identifier from stg_hubspot__deal; used to left join owner details; NULLs pass through
      - name: portal_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: HubSpot portal/account identifier from stg_hubspot__deal; NULLs pass through
      - name: deal_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deal name/title from stg_hubspot__deal; original casing and spacing preserved; NULLs pass through
      - name: description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Free-text deal description from stg_hubspot__deal; no trimming or normalization; NULLs pass through
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Deal amount from stg_hubspot__deal; precision/scale preserved; no re-aggregation or rounding; NULLs pass through
      - name: closed_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Deal closed timestamp from stg_hubspot__deal; passed through as-is; NULLs pass through
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Deal created timestamp from stg_hubspot__deal; passed through as-is; NULLs pass through
      - name: is_deal_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Deletion flag from stg_hubspot__deal; passed through without modification; NULLs pass through
      - name: _fivetran_synced
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Last sync timestamp from stg_hubspot__deal; timezone preserved; NULLs pass through
      - name: is_deal_pipeline_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Pipeline deletion flag set to false for all rows; remains false even when no pipeline match
      - name: pipeline_label
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline label from stg_hubspot__deal_pipeline (joined on deal_pipeline_id); NULL if no match; duplicates propagate
      - name: is_pipeline_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Pipeline active flag from stg_hubspot__deal_pipeline (joined on deal_pipeline_id); NULL if no match; duplicates propagate

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_hubspot__email_aggregate_status_change
      schema: intermediate
      description: Counts of 'UNSUBSCRIBED' status changes per email_send_id and email_campaign_id from joined HubSpot event/status tables
      grain: One row per (email_campaign_id, email_send_id) where email_send_id is not null
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_hubspot__email_event
      - staging.stg_hubspot__email_event_status_change
      business_logic: '- Inner join staging.stg_hubspot__email_event to staging.stg_hubspot__email_event_status_change on email_event_id (matched rows only). - Select events.sent_by_id as email_send_id, events.email_campaign_id, and status.subscription_status from the join. - Exclude rows with NULL email_send_id prior to aggregation. - Group by email_campaign_id and email_send_id; output one row per group. - Compute unsubscribes as the number of rows in the group whose subscription_status equals the literal UNSUBSCRIBED. Determinism: - Exact literal match ''UNSUBSCRIBED'' (case-sensitive); no trimming or normalization. - Duplicates preserved; every qualifying row counts. - Non-qualifying rows contribute 0; result is an integer ≥ 0 and never NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: email_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier from events used for grouping; may be NULL; duplicates allowed
      - name: email_send_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier from events.sent_by_id used for grouping; NULLs removed before aggregation so output is always non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: unsubscribes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of rows in the group with subscription_status equal to UNSUBSCRIBED; integer ≥ 0; never NULL; duplicates preserved; case-sensitive match
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: int_hubspot__email_event_aggregates
      schema: intermediate
      description: Aggregates email events into per-send counts by event type.
      grain: One row per email_send_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_hubspot__email_event
      business_logic: '- Source: staging.stg_hubspot__email_event. - Include only rows where sent_by_id is not null. - Group by sent_by_id and output one row per distinct value as email_send_id. - For each group, count events separately for these types: OPEN, SENT, DELIVERED, DROPPED, CLICK, FORWARD, DEFERRED, BOUNCE, SPAMREPORT, PRINT. - Only rows with non-null email_event_id contribute to counts; if a type has no qualifying rows, its count is 0. - Event type matching is exact; no case normalization or trimming is applied. - Duplicates are not removed; each qualifying row adds 1 to its type’s count. - No joins, ordering, windowing, or additional filtering is applied beyond the above.'
      columns:
      - name: email_send_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier from sent_by_id; one row per non-null sent_by_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: opens
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of OPEN events with a non-null email_event_id for this send.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_hubspot__email_marketing_attribution
      schema: intermediate
      description: Email campaign-level attribution metrics and ROI tiers derived from recipient engagement and associated deals
      grain: One row per email_campaign_id
      source_models:
      - raw.email_event_data
      - staging.stg_hubspot__contact
      - raw.deal_contact_data
      - raw.deal_data
      business_logic: '- Build email_events_enhanced from raw.email_event_data: - Keep rows with a recipient present; set event type flags (sent, delivered, open, click, bounce, unsubscribe) to 1 when matched, else 0. - Derive event_timestamp by parsing the created field as a datetime from the first 19 characters when created is present, not equal to ''almost'', and its length is at least 19; otherwise set to NULL. - Aggregate campaign_performance_base per non-null email_campaign_id: - unique_recipients = count of distinct recipient. - total_sends, total_deliveries, total_opens, total_clicks = sums of corresponding flags. - open_rate = (total_opens ÷ total_deliveries) × 100 when total_deliveries > 0, else 0. - click_through_rate = (total_clicks ÷ total_opens) × 100 when total_opens > 0, else 0. - Build recipient_engagement_journey per (recipient, email_campaign_id) where both are non-null: - first_send_time/open_time/click_time = earliest event_timestamp for SENT/OPEN/CLICK; last_open_time/last_click_time = latest for OPEN/CLICK. - minutes_to_first_open = minutes between first_send_time and first_open_time; minutes_from_open_to_click = minutes between first_open_time and first_click_time. - engagement_level: Highly Engaged if any click; Moderately Engaged if opens ≥ 3; Lightly Engaged if opens ≥ 1; else No Engagement. - Attribute deals (email_to_deal_attribution): - Join recipient_engagement_journey to contacts by recipient email, then to deal-contact links by contact_id, then to deal details by deal_id. - attribution_type priority: Click Attribution if deal creation is within 30 days after first_click_time; else Open Attribution within 30 days after first_open_time; else Send Attribution within 30 days after first_send_time; else No Attribution. - days_from_click_to_deal = whole days from first_click_time to deal creation when both exist; else NULL. - Compute campaign_roi_metrics by left joining campaign_performance_base to email_to_deal_attribution and grouping per campaign: - attributed_deals = distinct count of deals with attribution_type other than No Attribution. - attributed_revenue = sum of deal_amount for attributed deals that have a close date; if no matches, 0; duplicates from joins are not de-duplicated. - revenue_per_send = attributed_revenue ÷ total_sends when total_sends > 0, else 0. - revenue_per_recipient = attributed_revenue ÷ unique_recipients when unique_recipients > 0, else 0. - lead_conversion_rate = (attributed_deals ÷ unique_recipients) × 100 when unique_recipients > 0, else 0. - avg_days_to_conversion = average of days_from_click_to_deal for rows with attribution (NULLs excluded); if none, NULL. - Final derive tiers and result set: - campaign_performance_tier: High Performing if open_rate ≥ 25 and click_through_rate ≥ 5 and lead_conversion_rate ≥ 2; else Good Performing if open_rate ≥ 15 and click_through_rate ≥ 2 and lead_conversion_rate ≥ 1; else Average Performing if open_rate ≥ 10 and click_through_rate ≥ 1; else Underperforming. - roi_tier: Excellent ROI if revenue_per_send ≥ 50; Good ROI if ≥ 20; Moderate ROI if ≥ 5; else Low ROI. - Filter to non-null email_campaign_id and order rows by attributed_revenue descending.'
      columns:
      - name: email_campaign_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique identifier of the email campaign; grouping key; exactly one output row per value
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: unique_recipients
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of recipient emails in the campaign; duplicates removed; NULL recipients excluded
      - name: total_sends
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total SENT events for the campaign; sum of is_sent flags across all event rows; recipients may have multiple sends
      - name: open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage = total_opens ÷ total_deliveries × 100; if total_deliveries = 0 → 0; no rounding
      - name: click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage = total_clicks ÷ total_opens × 100; if total_opens = 0 → 0; no rounding
      - name: attributed_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Distinct count of deals attributed within 30 days of first click/open/send (priority: click > open > send); excludes No Attribution; 0 if none'
      - name: attributed_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of deal_amount for attributed deals with a close date; duplicates from joins are preserved; if none → 0
      - name: revenue_per_send
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Attributed revenue divided by total_sends; if total_sends = 0 → 0; no rounding
      - name: revenue_per_recipient
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Attributed revenue divided by unique_recipients; if unique_recipients = 0 → 0; no rounding
      - name: lead_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage = attributed_deals ÷ unique_recipients × 100; if unique_recipients = 0 → 0; no rounding
      - name: avg_days_to_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from first click to deal creation for attributed rows; NULLs excluded; if none → NULL
      - name: campaign_performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier label based on thresholds: High (open_rate ≥ 25, click_through_rate ≥ 5, lead_conversion_rate ≥ 2); Good (open_rate ≥ 15, click_through_rate ≥ 2, lead_conversion_rate ≥ 1); Average (open_rate ≥ 10, click_through_rate ≥ 1); else Underperforming'
      - name: roi_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier label based on revenue_per_send: Excellent (≥ 50), Good (≥ 20), Moderate (≥ 5), else Low'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Build email_events_enhanced from raw.email_event_data: - Keep rows with a recipient present; set event type flags (sent, delivered, open, click, bounce, unsubscribe) to 1 when matched, else 0. - Derive event_timestamp by parsing the created field as a datetime from the first 19 characters when created is present, not equal to ''almost'', and its length is at least 19; otherwise set to NULL. - Aggregate campaign_performance_base per non-null email_campaign_id: - unique_recipients = count of distinct recipient. - total_sends, total_deliveries, total_opens, total_clicks = sums of corresponding flags. - open_rate = (total_opens ÷ total_deliveries) × 100 when total_deliveries > 0, else 0. - click_through_rate = (total_clicks ÷ total_opens) × 100 when total_opens > 0, else 0. - Build recipient_engagement_journey per (recipient, email_campaign_id) where both are non-null: - first_send_time/open_time/click_time = earliest event_timestamp for SENT/OPEN/CLICK; last_open_time/last_click_time = latest for OPEN/CLICK. - minutes_to_first_open = minutes between first_send_time and first_open_time; minutes_from_open_to_click = minutes between first_open_time and first_click_time. - engagement_level: Highly Engaged if any click; Moderately Engaged if opens ≥ 3; Lightly Engaged if opens ≥ 1; else No Engagement. - Attribute deals (email_to_deal_attribution): - Join recipient_engagement_journey to contacts by recipient email, then to deal-contact links by contact_id, then to deal details by deal_id. - attribution_type priority: Click Attribution if deal creation is within 30 days after first_click_time; else Open Attribution within 30 days after first_open_time; else Send Attribution within 30 days after first_send_time; else No Attribution. - days_from_click_to_deal = whole days from first_click_time to deal creation when both exist; else NULL. - Compute campaign_roi_metrics by left joining campaign_performance_base to email_to_deal_attribution and grouping per campaign: - attributed_deals = distinct count of deals with attribution_type other than No Attribution. - attributed_revenue = sum of deal_amount for attributed deals that have a close date; if no matches, 0; duplicates from joins are not de-duplicated. - revenue_per_send = attributed_revenue ÷ total_sends when total_sends > 0, else 0. - revenue_per_recipient = attributed_revenue ÷ unique_recipients when unique_recipients > 0, else 0. - lead_conversion_rate = (attributed_deals ÷ unique_recipients) × 100 when unique_recipients > 0, else 0. - avg_days_to_conversion = average of days_from_click_to_deal for rows with attribution (NULLs excluded); if none, NULL. - Final derive tiers and result set: - campaign_performance_tier: High Performing if open_rate ≥ 25 and click_through_rate ≥ 5 and lead_conversion_rate ≥ 2; else Good Performing if open_rate ≥ 15 and click_through_rate ≥ 2 and lead_conversion_rate ≥ 1; else Average Performing if open_rate ≥ 10 and click_through_rate ≥ 1; else Underperforming. - roi_tier: Excellent ROI if revenue_per_send ≥ 50; Good ROI if ≥ 20; Moderate ROI if ≥ 5; else Low ROI. - Filter to non-null email_campaign_id and order rows by attributed_revenue descending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics
      schema: intermediate
      description: Sales owner performance metrics with counts, revenue, cycle times, rankings, percentiles, and rule-based classifications
      grain: One row per owner_id with at least one deal
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced (owner_id, amount, pipeline_stage_label, pipeline_label, deal_pipeline_stage_id, created_date, closed_date)
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__owners_enhanced (owner_id, owner_full_name, owner_email_address)
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced, keeping only deals with a non-NULL owner_id. - For each deal, derive: - deal_status: Won if closed_date is present and amount > 0; Lost if closed_date is present and amount = 0; Open if closed_date is missing; otherwise Unknown. - deal_size_category: Enterprise (100K+) if amount >= 100000; Large (50K-100K) if amount >= 50000; Medium (10K-50K) if amount >= 10000; Small (<10K) if amount > 0; else No Value. - deal_cycle_time_days: number of days between created_date and closed_date when both exist; otherwise NULL. - Left join to intermediate.int_hubspot__owners_enhanced on owner_id to bring owner_full_name and owner_email_address. - Aggregate by owner_id, owner_name, owner_email: - Counts: total_deals (all deals); won_deals (status Won); lost_deals (status Lost); open_deals (status Open). - Win rate: wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; if there are no closed (Won/Lost) deals then 0. - Revenue: total_won_revenue = sum of amounts from Won deals (non-won contribute 0; NULL amounts are ignored); avg_won_deal_size = average amount for Won deals (NULL if none); pipeline_value = sum of amounts from Open deals (non-open contribute 0; NULL amounts are ignored). - Velocity: avg_won_cycle_time = average cycle days for Won; avg_lost_cycle_time = average cycle days for Lost (both NULL if none). - Dates: first_deal_date = earliest created_date; latest_deal_date = latest created_date; last_won_date = latest close_date among Won. - Size distribution: counts of Enterprise, Large, Medium, and Small as defined above. - Size-specific win rates: within Enterprise and Large respectively, wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; if no closed deals in that size then 0. - Keep only owners with total_deals > 0. - Compute window metrics across all remaining owners (no partitions): - revenue_rank: position when ordering by total_won_revenue descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - win_rate_rank: position when ordering by win_rate_percentage descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - deals_won_rank: position when ordering by won_deals descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - cycle_time_rank: position when ordering by average won cycle time ascending; missing averages are treated as 999 days (1 = shortest). - revenue_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by total_won_revenue (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - win_rate_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by win_rate_percentage (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - volume_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by won_deals (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - efficiency_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by average won cycle time in descending order with missing treated as 999 (0 = slowest or NULL, 100 = fastest). - overall_performance_score: take the percentile ranks (0–1) for revenue, win rate, won deals, and cycle time (faster = higher), weight them 40/25/20/15 respectively, sum them, then multiply by 100; the score ranges from 0 to 10000. - Classifications: - performance_tier: Top Performer if score >= 80; High Performer if >= 60; Core Performer if >= 40; Developing Performer if >= 20; else Needs Improvement. - sales_specialization: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_deals > (large_deals + medium_deals + small_deals); Large Deal Specialist if large_deals > (enterprise_deals + medium_deals + small_deals); Generalist if the total across size categories >= 3; else Focused Seller. - development_focus (first match applies): if win_rate_percentage < 15 and avg_won_cycle_time > 90 then Focus on Qualification and Process; else if win_rate_percentage < 15 then Improve Win Rate; else if avg_won_cycle_time > 120 then Accelerate Sales Cycle; else if won_deals < 5 then Increase Activity Volume; else Maintain Current Performance. - pipeline_health_status (evaluated in order): Strong Pipeline if pipeline_value >= 2 × total_won_revenue; Healthy Pipeline if >= total_won_revenue; Adequate Pipeline if >= 0.5 × total_won_revenue; else Weak Pipeline.'
      columns:
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales owner identifier and grouping key; one row per owner with at least one deal
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: owner_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner full name from owners_enhanced; may be NULL if no match
      - name: owner_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner email from owners_enhanced; may be NULL if no match
      - name: total_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of the owner's deals across all statuses
      - name: won_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of closed deals with amount > 0
      - name: lost_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of closed deals with amount = 0
      - name: open_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals with no closed_date
      - name: win_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; returns 0 if there are no closed deals; no rounding
      - name: total_won_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total amount from won deals; non-won contribute 0 and NULL amounts are ignored; 2-decimal scale
      - name: avg_won_deal_size
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average amount for won deals; excludes NULLs; NULL if no won deals
      - name: pipeline_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total amount from open deals; non-open contribute 0 and NULL amounts are ignored; 2-decimal scale
      - name: avg_won_cycle_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from created to closed for won deals; NULL if none
      - name: avg_lost_cycle_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days from created to closed for lost deals; NULL if none
      - name: first_deal_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest created_date across the owner's deals; NULL if all created_date values are NULL
      - name: latest_deal_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest created_date across the owner's deals; NULL if all created_date values are NULL
      - name: last_won_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent close_date among won deals; NULL if no won deals
      - name: enterprise_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals with amount >= 100000
      - name: large_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals with 50000 <= amount < 100000
      - name: medium_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals with 10000 <= amount < 50000
      - name: small_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of deals with 0 < amount < 10000
      - name: enterprise_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Within Enterprise size, wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; returns 0 if no closed Enterprise deals
      - name: large_deal_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Within Large size, wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; returns 0 if no closed Large deals
      - name: revenue_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position when ordering all owners by total won revenue descending; 1 is highest; ties break arbitrarily
      - name: win_rate_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position when ordering all owners by win rate percentage descending; 1 is highest; ties break arbitrarily
      - name: deals_won_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position when ordering all owners by number of won deals descending; 1 is highest; ties break arbitrarily
      - name: cycle_time_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position when ordering by average won cycle time ascending; 1 is shortest; missing averages treated as 999 days; ties break arbitrarily
      - name: revenue_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank scaled 0–100 by total won revenue; 0 = lowest, 100 = highest
      - name: win_rate_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank scaled 0–100 by win rate percentage; 0 = lowest, 100 = highest
      - name: volume_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank scaled 0–100 by number of won deals; 0 = lowest, 100 = highest
      - name: efficiency_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile rank scaled 0–100 by average won cycle time in descending order with missing treated as 999; 0 = slowest/NULL, 100 = fastest
      - name: overall_performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted sum of percentile ranks (0–1) for revenue, win rate, won deals, and cycle time (faster is higher) with weights 40/25/20/15, multiplied by 100; range 0–10000
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from overall_performance_score: >=80 Top Performer; >=60 High Performer; >=40 Core Performer; >=20 Developing Performer; else Needs Improvement'
      - name: sales_specialization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_deals > (large+medium+small); Large Deal Specialist if large_deals > (enterprise+medium+small); Generalist if total size-deal count >= 3; else Focused Seller
      - name: development_focus
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority rules: if win_rate_percentage < 15 and avg_won_cycle_time > 90 then Focus on Qualification and Process; else if win_rate_percentage < 15 then Improve Win Rate; else if avg_won_cycle_time > 120 then Accelerate Sales Cycle; else if won_deals < 5 then Increase Activity Volume; else Maintain Current Performance'
      - name: pipeline_health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Pipeline status by comparing pipeline_value to total_won_revenue: >=2x Strong; >=1x Healthy; >=0.5x Adequate; else Weak'

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__deals_enhanced, keeping only deals with a non-NULL owner_id. - For each deal, derive: - deal_status: Won if closed_date is present and amount > 0; Lost if closed_date is present and amount = 0; Open if closed_date is missing; otherwise Unknown. - deal_size_category: Enterprise (100K+) if amount >= 100000; Large (50K-100K) if amount >= 50000; Medium (10K-50K) if amount >= 10000; Small (<10K) if amount > 0; else No Value. - deal_cycle_time_days: number of days between created_date and closed_date when both exist; otherwise NULL. - Left join to intermediate.int_hubspot__owners_enhanced on owner_id to bring owner_full_name and owner_email_address. - Aggregate by owner_id, owner_name, owner_email: - Counts: total_deals (all deals); won_deals (status Won); lost_deals (status Lost); open_deals (status Open). - Win rate: wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; if there are no closed (Won/Lost) deals then 0. - Revenue: total_won_revenue = sum of amounts from Won deals (non-won contribute 0; NULL amounts are ignored); avg_won_deal_size = average amount for Won deals (NULL if none); pipeline_value = sum of amounts from Open deals (non-open contribute 0; NULL amounts are ignored). - Velocity: avg_won_cycle_time = average cycle days for Won; avg_lost_cycle_time = average cycle days for Lost (both NULL if none). - Dates: first_deal_date = earliest created_date; latest_deal_date = latest created_date; last_won_date = latest close_date among Won. - Size distribution: counts of Enterprise, Large, Medium, and Small as defined above. - Size-specific win rates: within Enterprise and Large respectively, wins divided by (wins + losses) times 100; if no closed deals in that size then 0. - Keep only owners with total_deals > 0. - Compute window metrics across all remaining owners (no partitions): - revenue_rank: position when ordering by total_won_revenue descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - win_rate_rank: position when ordering by win_rate_percentage descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - deals_won_rank: position when ordering by won_deals descending (1 = highest; ties break arbitrarily). - cycle_time_rank: position when ordering by average won cycle time ascending; missing averages are treated as 999 days (1 = shortest). - revenue_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by total_won_revenue (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - win_rate_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by win_rate_percentage (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - volume_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by won_deals (lowest = 0, highest = 100). - efficiency_percentile: percentile rank scaled 0–100 by average won cycle time in descending order with missing treated as 999 (0 = slowest or NULL, 100 = fastest). - overall_performance_score: take the percentile ranks (0–1) for revenue, win rate, won deals, and cycle time (faster = higher), weight them 40/25/20/15 respectively, sum them, then multiply by 100; the score ranges from 0 to 10000. - Classifications: - performance_tier: Top Performer if score >= 80; High Performer if >= 60; Core Performer if >= 40; Developing Performer if >= 20; else Needs Improvement. - sales_specialization: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_deals > (large_deals + medium_deals + small_deals); Large Deal Specialist if large_deals > (enterprise_deals + medium_deals + small_deals); Generalist if the total across size categories >= 3; else Focused Seller. - development_focus (first match applies): if win_rate_percentage < 15 and avg_won_cycle_time > 90 then Focus on Qualification and Process; else if win_rate_percentage < 15 then Improve Win Rate; else if avg_won_cycle_time > 120 then Accelerate Sales Cycle; else if won_deals < 5 then Increase Activity Volume; else Maintain Current Performance. - pipeline_health_status (evaluated in order): Strong Pipeline if pipeline_value >= 2 × total_won_revenue; Healthy Pipeline if >= total_won_revenue; Adequate Pipeline if >= 0.5 × total_won_revenue; else Weak Pipeline.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: hubspot__campaign_performance_analysis
      schema: marketing
      description: Email campaign analytics with engagement rates, global benchmarking, scoring, classifications, and simplified attribution (one row per email_campaign_id)
      grain: One row per email_campaign_id
      source_models:
      - raw.email_event_data
      business_logic: 'Build campaign_engagement_metrics (cem) from raw.email_event_data: - Keep records with a non-null email_campaign_id; aggregate by email_campaign_id. - unique_recipients: number of distinct non-null recipients for the campaign. - total_sends: number of events where type is SENT. - open_rate (%): if total_sends > 0, then (number of OPEN events ÷ total_sends) × 100; otherwise 0. - click_through_rate (%): if total opens > 0, then (number of CLICK events ÷ number of OPEN events) × 100; otherwise 0. - delivery_rate (%): constant 95.0 for all campaigns. - bounce_rate (%): if total_sends > 0, then (number of BOUNCE events ÷ total_sends) × 100; otherwise 0. - unsubscribe_rate (%): if total_sends > 0, then (number of UNSUBSCRIBE events ÷ total_sends) × 100; otherwise 0. Build campaign_benchmarking (cb) from cem (global across all campaigns): - benchmark_open_rate: average of open_rate across campaigns. - benchmark_click_rate: average of click_through_rate across campaigns. - top_quartile_open_rate: 75th percentile of open_rate across campaigns. - top_quartile_click_rate: 75th percentile of click_through_rate across campaigns. Final output: - Cross join cem with cb so each campaign receives the same benchmark metrics; one row per email_campaign_id. - engagement_quality_score: sum of four bucketed components: - Open rate: ≥25 → 25; ≥15 → 20; ≥10 → 15; else 10. - Click-through rate: ≥5 → 25; ≥3 → 20; ≥1 → 15; else 10. - Bounce rate: ≤2 → 20; ≤5 → 15; ≤10 → 10; else 5. - Unsubscribe rate: ≤0.5 → 15; ≤1 → 12; ≤2 → 8; else 5. - campaign_performance_tier: - High Performing if open_rate ≥ 25 and click_through_rate ≥ 5; Good Performing if open_rate ≥ 15 and click_through_rate ≥ 2; Average Performing if open_rate ≥ 10 and click_through_rate ≥ 1; else Underperforming. - roi_tier: constant ''Low ROI''. - open_rate_performance: Above Benchmark if open_rate ≥ top quartile; At Benchmark if ≥ global average; else Below Benchmark. - click_rate_performance: Above Benchmark if click_through_rate ≥ top quartile; At Benchmark if ≥ global average; else Below Benchmark. - revenue_performance: constant ''At Benchmark''. - Audience engagement simplifications: highly_engaged_recipients = unique_recipients; moderately_engaged_recipients = 0; lightly_engaged_recipients = 0; no_engagement_recipients = 0; highly_engaged_percentage = 100.0. - avg_response_time_minutes = 60; avg_opens_per_recipient = 2.5; avg_clicks_per_recipient = 0.5. - Simplified attribution constants: attributed_deals = 0; attributed_revenue = 0; revenue_per_send = 0; revenue_per_recipient = 0; lead_conversion_rate = 0; deals_per_send_rate = 0; avg_days_to_conversion = 30; avg_deal_size_from_campaign = 0. - optimization_recommendation (evaluated in order; first match wins): - If open_rate < benchmark_open_rate → ''Optimize Subject Line''; else if click_through_rate < benchmark_click_rate → ''Improve Content/CTA''; else if bounce_rate > 5 → ''Clean Email List''; else if unsubscribe_rate > 1 → ''Review Content Relevance''; else → ''Maintain Current Strategy''. - overall_campaign_success: - Highly Successful if engagement_quality_score ≥ 80; Successful if ≥ 60; Moderately Successful if ≥ 40; else Needs Improvement. - Final query sorts by unique_recipients descending; physical storage does not guarantee row order.'
      columns:
      - name: email_campaign_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: HubSpot email campaign identifier and grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: unique_recipients
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct non-null recipients for the campaign
      - name: total_sends
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Number of SENT events for the campaign
      - name: open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Opens ÷ sends × 100; 0 when sends=0
      - name: click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Clicks ÷ opens × 100; 0 when opens=0
      - name: attributed_deals
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified attribution placeholder set to 0
      - name: attributed_revenue
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified attribution placeholder set to 0
      - name: revenue_per_send
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified attribution placeholder set to 0
      - name: revenue_per_recipient
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified attribution placeholder set to 0
      - name: lead_conversion_rate
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified attribution placeholder set to 0
      - name: avg_days_to_conversion
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Constant 30 days as simplified conversion timing
      - name: campaign_performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tier based on open and click thresholds
      - name: roi_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ROI classification set to 'Low ROI'
      - name: avg_response_time_minutes
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Average response time set to 60 minutes
      - name: avg_deal_size_from_campaign
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified attribution placeholder set to 0
      - name: avg_clicks_per_recipient
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Average clicks per recipient set to 0.5
      - name: highly_engaged_recipients
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Set equal to unique_recipients for simplified engagement
      - name: lightly_engaged_recipients
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified engagement bucket set to 0
      - name: avg_opens_per_recipient
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Average opens per recipient set to 2.5
      - name: benchmark_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Global average open_rate across campaigns
      - name: highly_engaged_percentage

      - name: revenue_performance

      - name: overall_campaign_success

references.name: raw.email_event_data
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build campaign_engagement_metrics (cem) from raw.email_event_data: - Keep records with a non-null email_campaign_id; aggregate by email_campaign_id. - unique_recipients: number of distinct non-null recipients for the campaign. - total_sends: number of events where type is SENT. - open_rate (%): if total_sends > 0, then (number of OPEN events ÷ total_sends) × 100; otherwise 0. - click_through_rate (%): if total opens > 0, then (number of CLICK events ÷ number of OPEN events) × 100; otherwise 0. - delivery_rate (%): constant 95.0 for all campaigns. - bounce_rate (%): if total_sends > 0, then (number of BOUNCE events ÷ total_sends) × 100; otherwise 0. - unsubscribe_rate (%): if total_sends > 0, then (number of UNSUBSCRIBE events ÷ total_sends) × 100; otherwise 0. Build campaign_benchmarking (cb) from cem (global across all campaigns): - benchmark_open_rate: average of open_rate across campaigns. - benchmark_click_rate: average of click_through_rate across campaigns. - top_quartile_open_rate: 75th percentile of open_rate across campaigns. - top_quartile_click_rate: 75th percentile of click_through_rate across campaigns. Final output: - Cross join cem with cb so each campaign receives the same benchmark metrics; one row per email_campaign_id. - engagement_quality_score: sum of four bucketed components: - Open rate: ≥25 → 25; ≥15 → 20; ≥10 → 15; else 10. - Click-through rate: ≥5 → 25; ≥3 → 20; ≥1 → 15; else 10. - Bounce rate: ≤2 → 20; ≤5 → 15; ≤10 → 10; else 5. - Unsubscribe rate: ≤0.5 → 15; ≤1 → 12; ≤2 → 8; else 5. - campaign_performance_tier: - High Performing if open_rate ≥ 25 and click_through_rate ≥ 5; Good Performing if open_rate ≥ 15 and click_through_rate ≥ 2; Average Performing if open_rate ≥ 10 and click_through_rate ≥ 1; else Underperforming. - roi_tier: constant ''Low ROI''. - open_rate_performance: Above Benchmark if open_rate ≥ top quartile; At Benchmark if ≥ global average; else Below Benchmark. - click_rate_performance: Above Benchmark if click_through_rate ≥ top quartile; At Benchmark if ≥ global average; else Below Benchmark. - revenue_performance: constant ''At Benchmark''. - Audience engagement simplifications: highly_engaged_recipients = unique_recipients; moderately_engaged_recipients = 0; lightly_engaged_recipients = 0; no_engagement_recipients = 0; highly_engaged_percentage = 100.0. - avg_response_time_minutes = 60; avg_opens_per_recipient = 2.5; avg_clicks_per_recipient = 0.5. - Simplified attribution constants: attributed_deals = 0; attributed_revenue = 0; revenue_per_send = 0; revenue_per_recipient = 0; lead_conversion_rate = 0; deals_per_send_rate = 0; avg_days_to_conversion = 30; avg_deal_size_from_campaign = 0. - optimization_recommendation (evaluated in order; first match wins): - If open_rate < benchmark_open_rate → ''Optimize Subject Line''; else if click_through_rate < benchmark_click_rate → ''Improve Content/CTA''; else if bounce_rate > 5 → ''Clean Email List''; else if unsubscribe_rate > 1 → ''Review Content Relevance''; else → ''Maintain Current Strategy''. - overall_campaign_success: - Highly Successful if engagement_quality_score ≥ 80; Successful if ≥ 60; Moderately Successful if ≥ 40; else Needs Improvement. - Final query sorts by unique_recipients descending; physical storage does not guarantee row order.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: hubspot__contact_engagement_analysis
      schema: marketing
      description: Comprehensive contact engagement metrics, lifecycle analysis, and email attribution-derived scoring
      grain: One row per contact_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_lifecycle_metrics
      - staging.stg_hubspot__contact
      - raw.email_event_data
      business_logic: '1) Base: bring all lifecycle and deal metrics from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_lifecycle_metrics (one row per contact_id). 2) Email attribution (per email): join contacts to email events on email=recipient; include only events where a campaign_id exists; aggregate by email to compute: - campaigns_engaged_with = distinct campaigns count - attributed_deals_count = 0; total_attributed_revenue = 0 (placeholders) - primary_attribution_type = ''Email''; avg_attribution_window_days = 30 (defaults) Only emails with at least one qualifying campaign event appear. 3) Final assembly: left join the email attribution dataset to the base on email; pass through all base fields; set: - email_campaigns_engaged = campaigns_engaged_with when present, else 0 - email_attributed_deals = attributed_deals_count when present, else 0 - email_attributed_revenue = total_attributed_revenue when present, else 0 - primary_attribution_type and avg_attribution_window_days are null when no attribution row exists. 4) Derived fields: - engagement_recency_status: compare last_engagement_date to today; in order: within 30 days → ''Recently Active''; within 90 → ''Moderately Active''; within 180 → ''Somewhat Active''; if a past date exists but older → ''Inactive''; if no engagement date → ''Never Engaged''. - customer_value_segment: evaluate in order by total_deal_value and then total_associated_deals: ≥50,000 → ''High Value Customer''; ≥10,000 → ''Medium Value Customer''; >0 → ''Low Value Customer''; else if any deals exist → ''Prospect with Opportunity''; else ''Lead Only''. - comprehensive_engagement_score: sum of four components capped at Email 40 + Deals 30 + Attribution 20 + Velocity 10: Email: if any emails were sent, use 0.2×open_rate + 0.2×click_through_rate, capped at 40; else 0. Deals: if any deals exist, use 6 points per deal, capped at 30; else 0. Attribution: if any attributed deals exist, use 10 points per attributed deal, capped at 20; else 0. Velocity: 0.1×conversion_velocity_score, capped at 10. If a >0 gate is not met, that component contributes 0; no additional null-imputation is applied, so null rate or velocity inputs can yield a null overall score. - days_from_creation_to_last_engagement: number of days between created_date and last_engagement_date; null if either date is missing. - revenue_per_email_sent: total_deal_value divided by total_emails_sent when both are >0; else 0. - revenue_per_day_known: total_deal_value divided by contact_age_days when both are >0; else 0. 5) Final labels: - final_engagement_classification: by comprehensive_engagement_score, in order: ≥80 ''Champion''; ≥60 ''Active Prospect''; ≥40 ''Engaged Lead''; ≥20 ''Warm Lead''; else ''Cold Lead''. - mql_classification: ''Marketing Qualified Lead'' if engagement_tier=''High Engagement'' and total_emails_clicked>0 and contact_maturity_segment in (''Established Contact'',''Mature Contact'') and engagement_recency_status in (''Recently Active'',''Moderately Active''); else ''Marketing Engaged Lead'' if engagement_tier in (''High Engagement'',''Medium Engagement'') and total_emails_opened≥3 and engagement_recency_status!=''Never Engaged''; else ''Unqualified Lead''. - sales_readiness_status: ''Sales Ready'' if total_associated_deals>0; else ''Sales Qualified'' if comprehensive_engagement_score≥60 and email_attributed_deals>0; else ''Sales Interested'' if comprehensive_engagement_score≥40 and total_emails_clicked>0; else ''Not Sales Ready''. Note: The final result is presented sorted by comprehensive_engagement_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique contact identifier; grouping key with exactly one output row per contact_id
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact email used to join to email attribution data; NULL yields no attribution row
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Datetime the contact record was created; used in date difference calculations
      - name: first_conversion_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Datetime of the contact’s first conversion event from lifecycle metrics
      - name: contact_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Age in whole days from created_date to current_date as defined in lifecycle metrics
      - name: days_to_conversion
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from created_date to first_conversion_date from lifecycle metrics
      - name: contact_maturity_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle maturity segment label from lifecycle metrics; used in MQL classification
      - name: conversion_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle conversion status label from lifecycle metrics
      - name: conversion_velocity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Velocity score from lifecycle metrics; contributes up to 10 points (0.1×score) to comprehensive_engagement_score
      - name: total_emails_sent
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total emails sent to the contact from lifecycle metrics; >0 gate for email weighting and revenue_per_email_sent
      - name: total_emails_opened
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total email opens from lifecycle metrics; used in MQL second-tier rule (≥3)
      - name: total_emails_clicked
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total email clicks from lifecycle metrics; used in MQL and sales readiness rules (>0)
      - name: total_emails_bounced
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total email bounces from lifecycle metrics
      - name: email_open_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Email open rate from lifecycle metrics (percentage 0–100); contributes open_rate×0.2 to the email component when emails were sent
      - name: email_click_through_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Email click-through rate from lifecycle metrics (percentage 0–100); contributes click_rate×0.2 to the email component when emails were sent
      - name: last_engagement_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent engagement datetime from lifecycle metrics; drives engagement_recency_status and date difference
      - name: total_associated_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total deals associated with the contact from lifecycle metrics; used in deal component and segmentation
      - name: total_closed_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total closed deals associated with the contact from lifecycle metrics
      - name: total_deal_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of deal values from lifecycle metrics; drives customer_value_segment and revenue efficiency metrics
      - name: avg_deal_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average deal value from lifecycle metrics
      - name: first_deal_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Datetime of the first associated deal from lifecycle metrics
      - name: last_deal_closed_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Datetime of the most recent closed deal from lifecycle metrics
      - name: overall_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Precomputed overall engagement score from lifecycle metrics (passthrough)
      - name: engagement_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Engagement tier label from lifecycle metrics; used in MQL classification
      - name: final_engagement_classification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification by comprehensive_engagement_score: Champion ≥80; Active Prospect ≥60; Engaged Lead ≥40; Warm Lead ≥20; else Cold Lead'
      - name: email_campaigns_engaged
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of non-null campaign_ids per email from email events; missing attribution row yields 0
      - name: email_attributed_deals
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified attributed deals count from email attribution data; missing attribution row yields 0 (placeholder 0)
      - name: engagement_recency_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recency category from last_engagement_date vs today: within 30d Recently Active; within 90d Moderately Active; within 180d Somewhat Active; else Inactive; NULL → Never Engaged'
      - name: customer_value_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Value segment by total_deal_value: High ≥50000; Medium ≥10000; Low >0; else Prospect with Opportunity if total_associated_deals>0; else Lead Only'
      - name: revenue_per_email_sent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_deal_value divided by total_emails_sent when both >0; else 0
      - name: mql_classification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MQL if High Engagement + clicks>0 + maturity in set + recent; else Marketing Engaged Lead if tier in set + opens≥3 + recency not Never; else Unqualified Lead
      - name: email_attributed_revenue
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Simplified attributed revenue from email attribution data; missing attribution row yields 0 (placeholder 0)
      - name: sales_readiness_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales Ready if total_associated_deals>0; else Sales Qualified if score≥60 and email_attributed_deals>0; else Sales Interested if score≥40 and clicks>0; else Not Sales Ready
      - name: primary_attribution_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary attribution channel from email attribution data; 'Email' when an attribution row exists; else NULL
      - name: revenue_per_day_known
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_deal_value divided by contact_age_days when both >0; else 0
      - name: avg_attribution_window_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Default attribution window in days from email attribution data (30 when an attribution row exists; else NULL)
      - name: comprehensive_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of capped components (Email 40, Deals 30, Attribution 20, Velocity 10); components are 0 when their >0 gates fail; null rate or velocity inputs can yield a null score
      - name: days_from_creation_to_last_engagement
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of days between created_date and last_engagement_date; NULL if either date is missing

references.name: intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_lifecycle_metrics
references.line_text: business_logic: '1) Base: bring all lifecycle and deal metrics from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_lifecycle_metrics (one row per contact_id). 2) Email attribution (per email): join contacts to email events on email=recipient; include only events where a campaign_id exists; aggregate by email to compute: - campaigns_engaged_with = distinct campaigns count - attributed_deals_count = 0; total_attributed_revenue = 0 (placeholders) - primary_attribution_type = ''Email''; avg_attribution_window_days = 30 (defaults) Only emails with at least one qualifying campaign event appear. 3) Final assembly: left join the email attribution dataset to the base on email; pass through all base fields; set: - email_campaigns_engaged = campaigns_engaged_with when present, else 0 - email_attributed_deals = attributed_deals_count when present, else 0 - email_attributed_revenue = total_attributed_revenue when present, else 0 - primary_attribution_type and avg_attribution_window_days are null when no attribution row exists. 4) Derived fields: - engagement_recency_status: compare last_engagement_date to today; in order: within 30 days → ''Recently Active''; within 90 → ''Moderately Active''; within 180 → ''Somewhat Active''; if a past date exists but older → ''Inactive''; if no engagement date → ''Never Engaged''. - customer_value_segment: evaluate in order by total_deal_value and then total_associated_deals: ≥50,000 → ''High Value Customer''; ≥10,000 → ''Medium Value Customer''; >0 → ''Low Value Customer''; else if any deals exist → ''Prospect with Opportunity''; else ''Lead Only''. - comprehensive_engagement_score: sum of four components capped at Email 40 + Deals 30 + Attribution 20 + Velocity 10: Email: if any emails were sent, use 0.2×open_rate + 0.2×click_through_rate, capped at 40; else 0. Deals: if any deals exist, use 6 points per deal, capped at 30; else 0. Attribution: if any attributed deals exist, use 10 points per attributed deal, capped at 20; else 0. Velocity: 0.1×conversion_velocity_score, capped at 10. If a >0 gate is not met, that component contributes 0; no additional null-imputation is applied, so null rate or velocity inputs can yield a null overall score. - days_from_creation_to_last_engagement: number of days between created_date and last_engagement_date; null if either date is missing. - revenue_per_email_sent: total_deal_value divided by total_emails_sent when both are >0; else 0. - revenue_per_day_known: total_deal_value divided by contact_age_days when both are >0; else 0. 5) Final labels: - final_engagement_classification: by comprehensive_engagement_score, in order: ≥80 ''Champion''; ≥60 ''Active Prospect''; ≥40 ''Engaged Lead''; ≥20 ''Warm Lead''; else ''Cold Lead''. - mql_classification: ''Marketing Qualified Lead'' if engagement_tier=''High Engagement'' and total_emails_clicked>0 and contact_maturity_segment in (''Established Contact'',''Mature Contact'') and engagement_recency_status in (''Recently Active'',''Moderately Active''); else ''Marketing Engaged Lead'' if engagement_tier in (''High Engagement'',''Medium Engagement'') and total_emails_opened≥3 and engagement_recency_status!=''Never Engaged''; else ''Unqualified Lead''. - sales_readiness_status: ''Sales Ready'' if total_associated_deals>0; else ''Sales Qualified'' if comprehensive_engagement_score≥60 and email_attributed_deals>0; else ''Sales Interested'' if comprehensive_engagement_score≥40 and total_emails_clicked>0; else ''Not Sales Ready''. Note: The final result is presented sorted by comprehensive_engagement_score descending.'
