blocks.original_text:
- name: hubspot__contacts
      schema: marketing
      description: Contacts from int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust enriched with email engagement aggregates from hubspot__email_sends joined by exact email match.
      grain: One row per contact_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust
      - marketing.hubspot__email_sends
      business_logic: '- Load all columns from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust as the contacts base. - From marketing.hubspot__email_sends, aggregate by recipient_email_address after excluding NULL addresses: - Totals: sum bounces, clicks, deferrals, deliveries, drops, forwards, opens, prints, spam_reports, unsubscribes; source NULL metric values do not contribute. - Unique sends: count distinct email_send_id where the corresponding metric value is strictly greater than 0; NULL metric values do not contribute. - Left join aggregated metrics to contacts on contacts.email = recipient_email_address using exact, case-sensitive equality; no trimming or normalization. - For contacts with no matching email metrics, set all aggregated outputs to 0. - If multiple contacts share the same email address, they receive the same aggregated metrics. - No additional filters or ordering are applied; output includes contacts.* plus the aggregated metric fields.'
      columns:
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary contact identifier from the source; one output row per contact_id.
      - name: calculated_merged_vids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Merged contact identifiers from the source passed through unchanged.
      - name: email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact email used to join metrics by exact, case-sensitive match to recipient_email_address.
      - name: first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First name passed through unchanged from the source.
      - name: last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last name passed through unchanged from the source.
      - name: contact_company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name associated with the contact passed through unchanged.
      - name: job_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job title passed through unchanged from the source.
      - name: company_annual_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Company annual revenue passed through unchanged as a decimal value.
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Contact creation date passed through unchanged.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Contact creation timestamp passed through unchanged.
      - name: first_conversion_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First conversion timestamp passed through unchanged.
      - name: is_contact_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Deletion flag passed through unchanged.
      - name: _fivetran_synced
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Fivetran sync timestamp passed through unchanged.
      - name: total_email_opens
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total opens across all email sends for the contact's email.
      - name: total_email_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks across all email sends for the contact's email.
      - name: total_email_bounces
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total bounces across all email sends for the contact's email.
      - name: total_unique_email_prints
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct email sends with prints greater than 0 for the contact's email.
      - name: total_unique_email_drops
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct email sends with drops greater than 0 for the contact's email.
      - name: total_email_deliveries
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total deliveries across all email sends for the contact's email.
      - name: total_email_drops
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total drops across all email sends for the contact's email.
      - name: total_email_forwards
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total forwards across all email sends for the contact's email.
      - name: total_unique_email_opens
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct email sends with opens greater than 0 for the contact's email.

references.name: intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Load all columns from intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust as the contacts base. - From marketing.hubspot__email_sends, aggregate by recipient_email_address after excluding NULL addresses: - Totals: sum bounces, clicks, deferrals, deliveries, drops, forwards, opens, prints, spam_reports, unsubscribes; source NULL metric values do not contribute. - Unique sends: count distinct email_send_id where the corresponding metric value is strictly greater than 0; NULL metric values do not contribute. - Left join aggregated metrics to contacts on contacts.email = recipient_email_address using exact, case-sensitive equality; no trimming or normalization. - For contacts with no matching email metrics, set all aggregated outputs to 0. - If multiple contacts share the same email address, they receive the same aggregated metrics. - No additional filters or ordering are applied; output includes contacts.* plus the aggregated metric fields.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: hubspot__email_event_sent
      schema: marketing
      description: Email send events with event attributes and contact match by recipient email.
      grain: Base grain is one row per stg_hubspot__email_event_sent record (email_event_id); joins may create multiple rows if joined sources have multiple matches.
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_hubspot__email_event_sent
      - staging.stg_hubspot__email_event
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust
      business_logic: '- Begin with all columns from staging.stg_hubspot__email_event_sent. - Left join staging.stg_hubspot__email_event on email_event_id and add: - created_timestamp from events - email_campaign_id from events - recipient_email_address from events - email_send_timestamp copied from the events created_timestamp - email_send_id copied from the events email_event_id - Left join intermediate.int_hubspot__contact_merge_adjust on recipient_email_address = contacts.email and add: - contact_id from contacts - is_contact_deleted defaulted to false when the contact flag is null or when no contact match exists - No filters or aggregations; all joins are left joins; base rows are preserved even without matches; no explicit ordering. - Join matching uses exact string matches; if multiple rows match in any joined source, the output contains one row per matching combination without de-duplication. - Null handling: fields from unmatched joins are null, except is_contact_deleted which is false by default.'
      columns:
      - name: email_event_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary event identifier from stg_hubspot__email_event_sent; not null.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: email_send_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event identifier sourced from stg_hubspot__email_event; equals email_event_id when an event match exists, else null.
      - name: email_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier from the matched event; null if no event match.
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Matched contact_id using recipient_email_address = contacts.email; null if no contact match.
      - name: recipient_email_address
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recipient email taken from the matched event; null if no event match.
      - name: email_send_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Send timestamp copied from the matched event's created timestamp; null if no event match.
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Event created timestamp from the matched event (same as email_send_timestamp); null if no event match.
      - name: email_from
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sender address from the base event; may be null.
      - name: email_reply_to
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reply-to address from the base event; may be null.
      - name: email_subject
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subject from the base event; may be null.
      - name: email_bcc
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: BCC recipients string from the base event; may be null.
      - name: email_cc
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: CC recipients string from the base event; may be null.
      - name: is_contact_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Contact deletion flag defaulted to false when null or when no contact match exists.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: _fivetran_synced
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Ingestion sync timestamp from the base event; timezone-aware; may be null.

blocks.original_text:
- name: hubspot__email_sends
      description: Email send events enriched with aggregated delivery, engagement, and unsubscribe counts plus boolean status flags derived from those counts
      grain: One row per source send event in marketing.hubspot__email_event_sent
      source_models:
      - marketing.hubspot__email_event_sent
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__email_event_aggregates
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__email_aggregate_status_change
      business_logic: '- Start with every row and all columns from marketing.hubspot__email_event_sent; no filtering or transformations are applied to these source fields. - Left join intermediate.int_hubspot__email_event_aggregates on email_send_id to add the pre-aggregated counts: bounces, clicks, deferrals, deliveries, drops, forwards, opens, prints, spam_reports. Replace any missing counts with 0; counts represent totals per email_send_id. - For each count, create a boolean that is True when the count is greater than zero and False otherwise: was_bounced from bounces, was_clicked from clicks, was_deferred from deferrals, was_delivered from deliveries, was_forwarded from forwards, was_opened from opens, was_printed from prints, was_spam_reported from spam_reports. These flags are never NULL. - Left join intermediate.int_hubspot__email_aggregate_status_change on email_send_id to add unsubscribes; replace missing values with 0. Set was_unsubscribed to True when unsubscribes is greater than zero and False otherwise. - Output includes all original send fields plus the coalesced counts, unsubscribes, and derived boolean flags; joins are left-sided and do not change the number of rows. - Grain and determinism: The result retains the exact row granularity of marketing.hubspot__email_event_sent; one output row per source row with no deduplication, sorting, or timezone changes.'
      columns:
      - name: email_send_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique identifier of the email send used for joins and defining table grain
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: email_event_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the specific HubSpot send event; passed through from source (NULLs preserved)
      - name: email_campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: HubSpot email campaign identifier for the send; passed through from source (NULLs preserved)
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: HubSpot contact identifier targeted by the send; passed through from source (NULLs preserved)
      - name: recipient_email_address
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recipient email address at time of send; exact string as stored (NULLs preserved; no trimming/casing changes)
      - name: email_send_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp the send event occurred; passed through from source (no timezone conversion; NULLs preserved)
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Record creation timestamp from source; passed through (no timezone conversion; NULLs preserved)
      - name: email_from
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: From address used for the send; passed through verbatim (NULLs preserved)
      - name: email_reply_to
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reply-To address configured for the email; passed through verbatim (NULLs preserved)
      - name: email_subject
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email subject line; passed through verbatim (NULLs preserved)
      - name: email_bcc
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: BCC addresses string as stored in source; passed through verbatim (NULLs preserved)
      - name: email_cc
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: CC addresses string as stored in source; passed through verbatim (NULLs preserved)
      - name: was_delivered
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when deliveries is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: was_opened
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when opens is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: was_clicked
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when clicks is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: was_bounced
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when bounces is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: was_deferred
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when deferrals is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: was_spam_reported
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when spam_reports is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: was_unsubscribed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when unsubscribes is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: was_forwarded
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when forwards is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: was_printed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when prints is greater than 0 after replacing NULL with 0; otherwise False
      - name: opens

        description: Total open events per email_send_id with NULL treated as 0; non-negative integer
      - name: clicks

      - name: prints

      - name: spam_reports

      - name: unsubscribes

Replace any missing counts with 0; counts represent totals per email_send_id. - For each count, create a boolean that is True when the count is greater than zero and False otherwise: was_bounced from bounces, was_clicked from clicks, was_deferred from deferrals, was_delivered from deliveries, was_forwarded from forwards, was_opened from opens, was_printed from prints, was_spam_reported from spam_reports. These flags are never NULL. - Left join intermediate.int_hubspot__email_aggregate_status_change on email_send_id to add unsubscribes; replace missing values with 0. Set was_unsubscribed to True when unsubscribes is greater than zero and False otherwise. - Output includes all original send fields plus the coalesced counts, unsubscribes, and derived boolean flags; joins are left-sided and do not change the number of rows. - Grain and determinism: The result retains the exact row granularity of marketing.hubspot__email_event_sent; one output row per source row with no deduplication, sorting, or timezone changes.'

- name: hubspot__sales_performance_dashboard
      schema: sales
      description: Quarterly sales performance metrics and forecasts derived from deal-level activity
      grain: One row per created_year and created_quarter
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics
      business_logic: '- Build quarterly_sales_metrics (qsm) from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics (dpb): - Keep records where created_year and created_quarter are present; aggregate by created_year, created_quarter. - Distinct counts of deal_id: total created, Won, Lost, Open; null deal_id never counted. - Revenue: - revenue_won_in_quarter: sum of deal_amount for Won deals; non-Won contribute zero; null amounts do not affect the sum. - pipeline_value_in_quarter: sum of deal_amount for Open deals; others contribute zero; null amounts ignored. - Averages and distribution for Won deals only: - avg_won_deal_size: average deal_amount; null amounts ignored; returns null if no values. - avg_sales_cycle_days: average deal_cycle_time_days; null values ignored; returns null if none. - median_sales_cycle_days: continuous 50th percentile of deal_cycle_time_days; null if none. - p25_deal_size: continuous 25th percentile of deal_amount; null if none. - p75_deal_size: continuous 75th percentile of deal_amount; null if none. - quarterly_win_rate (%): 100 times distinct Won divided by distinct Won+Lost; returns 0 if no Won+Lost. - active_sales_reps_in_quarter: distinct owner_id across all deals; null owner_id excluded. - Build forecast_metrics (fm), grouped by created_year, created_quarter: - total_open_pipeline: sum of deal_amount for Open deals; null amounts ignored. - weighted_pipeline_forecast: for Open deals, sum of deal_amount multiplied by the deal_size_category’s historical win rate (average of 1 for Won, 0 otherwise across all data); use 0.15 if no category history; null amounts ignored. - time_weighted_forecast: for Open deals with unknown cycle time, sum of deal_amount multiplied by a recency factor based on created_date relative to quarter boundaries at execution time (0.3 for current quarter, 0.5 for last quarter, 0.7 if older); null amounts ignored. - Left join qsm to fm on created_year and created_quarter. - Previous-quarter benchmarks: - Sort by created_year, created_quarter ascending; prev_quarter_revenue and prev_quarter_win_rate take the prior row’s values; first applicable row returns null. - Growth and indicators: - revenue_growth_rate (%): 100 times (current revenue_won_in_quarter minus previous) divided by previous; null if previous is null or not positive. - quarterly_performance_rating: Excellent if win_rate ≥ 30 and avg cycle ≤ 60; Good if win_rate ≥ 20 and avg cycle ≤ 90; Average if win_rate ≥ 15 and avg cycle ≤ 120; otherwise Below Average. - revenue_per_sales_rep: revenue_won_in_quarter divided by active_sales_reps_in_quarter; returns 0 if rep count is 0. - revenue_per_deal_created: revenue_won_in_quarter divided by deals_created_in_quarter; returns 0 if deal count is 0. - quarterly_goal_status: Exceeded Target if revenue_won_in_quarter ≥ 1,000,000; Met Target if ≥ 750,000; Close to Target if ≥ 500,000; otherwise Below Target. - Final output is sorted by created_year and created_quarter descending; the grain is one row per year-quarter.'
      columns:
      - name: created_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar year of deal creation; grouping key; never NULL in output
      - name: created_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Calendar quarter (1–4) of deal creation; grouping key; never NULL in output
      - name: deals_created_in_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deal_id in the quarter; NULL deal_id excluded
      - name: deals_won_in_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deal_id with status Won in the quarter; NULL deal_id excluded
      - name: deals_lost_in_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deal_id with status Lost in the quarter; NULL deal_id excluded
      - name: deals_still_open
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of deal_id with status Open in the quarter; NULL deal_id excluded
      - name: revenue_won_in_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for Won deals in the quarter; others contribute zero; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: pipeline_value_in_quarter
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for Open deals in the quarter; others contribute zero; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: total_open_pipeline
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for Open deals in the quarter from forecast metrics; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: quarterly_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Percentage: 100 × distinct Won divided by distinct Won+Lost for the quarter; returns 0 when none Closed'
      - name: prev_quarter_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Win rate from the previous quarter based on ascending year-quarter order; NULL for the first applicable row
      - name: prev_quarter_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Revenue_won_in_quarter from the previous quarter based on ascending year-quarter order; NULL for the first applicable row
      - name: revenue_growth_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs previous quarter revenue; NULL if previous is NULL or not positive
      - name: avg_won_deal_size
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average deal_amount for Won deals in the quarter; NULL amounts ignored; NULL if no values
      - name: p25_deal_size
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Continuous 25th percentile of deal_amount for Won deals in the quarter; NULL if no values
      - name: p75_deal_size
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Continuous 75th percentile of deal_amount for Won deals in the quarter; NULL if no values
      - name: avg_sales_cycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average deal_cycle_time_days for Won deals in the quarter; NULL values ignored; NULL if none
      - name: median_sales_cycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Continuous 50th percentile of deal_cycle_time_days for Won deals in the quarter; NULL if none
      - name: active_sales_reps_in_quarter
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of owner_id across all deals in the quarter; NULL owner_id excluded
      - name: revenue_per_sales_rep
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue_won_in_quarter divided by active_sales_reps_in_quarter; returns 0 when rep count is 0
      - name: revenue_per_deal_created
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue_won_in_quarter divided by deals_created_in_quarter; returns 0 when deal count is 0
      - name: weighted_pipeline_forecast
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum for Open deals of deal_amount × category win rate (average of 1 for Won, 0 otherwise by deal_size_category); uses 0.15 if no history; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: time_weighted_forecast
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum for Open deals with unknown cycle time of deal_amount × recency factor (0.3 current quarter, 0.5 last quarter, 0.7 older) using quarter boundaries at execution; NULL amounts ignored
      - name: quarterly_performance_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Rating determined by win rate and average cycle time using ordered thresholds
      - name: quarterly_goal_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Target attainment from revenue_won_in_quarter: ≥1,000,000 Exceeded, ≥750,000 Met, ≥500,000 Close, otherwise Below'

references.name: intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Build quarterly_sales_metrics (qsm) from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics (dpb): - Keep records where created_year and created_quarter are present; aggregate by created_year, created_quarter. - Distinct counts of deal_id: total created, Won, Lost, Open; null deal_id never counted. - Revenue: - revenue_won_in_quarter: sum of deal_amount for Won deals; non-Won contribute zero; null amounts do not affect the sum. - pipeline_value_in_quarter: sum of deal_amount for Open deals; others contribute zero; null amounts ignored. - Averages and distribution for Won deals only: - avg_won_deal_size: average deal_amount; null amounts ignored; returns null if no values. - avg_sales_cycle_days: average deal_cycle_time_days; null values ignored; returns null if none. - median_sales_cycle_days: continuous 50th percentile of deal_cycle_time_days; null if none. - p25_deal_size: continuous 25th percentile of deal_amount; null if none. - p75_deal_size: continuous 75th percentile of deal_amount; null if none. - quarterly_win_rate (%): 100 times distinct Won divided by distinct Won+Lost; returns 0 if no Won+Lost. - active_sales_reps_in_quarter: distinct owner_id across all deals; null owner_id excluded. - Build forecast_metrics (fm), grouped by created_year, created_quarter: - total_open_pipeline: sum of deal_amount for Open deals; null amounts ignored. - weighted_pipeline_forecast: for Open deals, sum of deal_amount multiplied by the deal_size_category’s historical win rate (average of 1 for Won, 0 otherwise across all data); use 0.15 if no category history; null amounts ignored. - time_weighted_forecast: for Open deals with unknown cycle time, sum of deal_amount multiplied by a recency factor based on created_date relative to quarter boundaries at execution time (0.3 for current quarter, 0.5 for last quarter, 0.7 if older); null amounts ignored. - Left join qsm to fm on created_year and created_quarter. - Previous-quarter benchmarks: - Sort by created_year, created_quarter ascending; prev_quarter_revenue and prev_quarter_win_rate take the prior row’s values; first applicable row returns null. - Growth and indicators: - revenue_growth_rate (%): 100 times (current revenue_won_in_quarter minus previous) divided by previous; null if previous is null or not positive. - quarterly_performance_rating: Excellent if win_rate ≥ 30 and avg cycle ≤ 60; Good if win_rate ≥ 20 and avg cycle ≤ 90; Average if win_rate ≥ 15 and avg cycle ≤ 120; otherwise Below Average. - revenue_per_sales_rep: revenue_won_in_quarter divided by active_sales_reps_in_quarter; returns 0 if rep count is 0. - revenue_per_deal_created: revenue_won_in_quarter divided by deals_created_in_quarter; returns 0 if deal count is 0. - quarterly_goal_status: Exceeded Target if revenue_won_in_quarter ≥ 1,000,000; Met Target if ≥ 750,000; Close to Target if ≥ 500,000; otherwise Below Target. - Final output is sorted by created_year and created_quarter descending; the grain is one row per year-quarter.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: hubspot__sales_rep_performance
      schema: sales
      description: Sales representative performance analytics with rankings, segment metrics, trends, and derived classifications
      grain: One row per owner_id (only reps with total_deals > 0)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics and retain only owners where total_deals > 0. - Build monthly deal performance per owner from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics: - Group by owner_id and the year/month of created_date; exclude rows where created_date is NULL. - monthly_deals_created: count distinct deal_id per month. - monthly_deals_won: count distinct deal_id where deal_status = ''Won''. - monthly_revenue: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Won'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_pipeline_added: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Open'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_win_rate: if decided deals (Won or Lost) exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - monthly_avg_cycle_time: average deal_cycle_time_days for won deals; NULL if none. - Aggregate per-owner trends over monthly data: - Use month_index = performance_year*12 + performance_month and current_month_index from current_date. - recent_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6 (inclusive). - prior_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7 (inclusive). - recent_6m_avg_win_rate / prior_6m_avg_win_rate: analogous averages over monthly_win_rate (percent values). - revenue_volatility: standard deviation of monthly_revenue; activity_consistency: standard deviation of monthly_deals_created. - recent_active_months: count of monthly rows in the last 3 calendar months (relative to current_date), inclusive. - Territory and segment analysis per owner from all deals: - primary_deal_segment: most frequent deal_size_category; ties break by ascending category label. - segments_covered: count distinct deal_size_category. - enterprise/large/medium/small_revenue: sum won deal_amount within each named deal_size_category. - enterprise_win_rate / large_deal_win_rate: if decided deals in the segment exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - Rankings and percentiles from owner metrics: - revenue_rank: best-to-worst by total_won_revenue; win_rate_rank: best-to-worst by win_rate_percentage; volume_rank: best-to-worst by won_deals. - efficiency_rank: best-to-worst by avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999. - revenue_percentile / win_rate_percentile / volume_percentile: percentile position (0–100) across all reps using ascending order of each metric; peers share the same percentile. - efficiency_percentile: percentile position (0–100) using descending order of avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999 (longer cycles → higher percentile). - overall_performance_score: weighted sum of these percentiles (revenue 40%, win rate 25%, volume 20%, efficiency 15%), then scaled by ×100 to a 0–10,000 range. - Ties in ranks are resolved by the database’s implicit peer order. - Join rankings to trends and territory by owner_id (cast trend/territory owner_id to VARCHAR); unmatched trend/territory values remain NULL. - Derivations: - revenue_trend_percentage: if prior_6m_avg_revenue > 0 and recent_6m_avg_revenue is not NULL, compute 100 × (recent - prior) / prior; else NULL. - win_rate_trend_points: if prior_6m_avg_win_rate > 0 and recent_6m_avg_win_rate is not NULL, compute recent - prior; else NULL. - performance_tier: >=80 Top Performer; >=60 High Performer; >=40 Core Performer; >=20 Developing Performer; else Needs Improvement. - performance_trend: >=20 Strong Growth; >=5 Steady Growth; >=-5 Stable; >=-20 Declining; else Significant Decline (NULLs map to the else). - sales_specialization: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_revenue strictly exceeds (large + medium + small); Large Deal Specialist if large_revenue strictly exceeds (enterprise + medium + small); else if segments_covered >= 3 then Generalist; otherwise Focused Seller. - development_focus (first-match order): low win rate + long cycle → Focus on Qualification and Process; low win rate → Improve Win Rate; very long cycle → Accelerate Sales Cycle; few wins → Increase Activity Volume; declining revenue trend → Address Performance Decline; else Maintain Current Performance. - activity_level (first-match): Highly Active (recent_active_months >= 3 and total_deals >= 10); Active (recent_active_months >= 2 and total_deals >= 5); Moderately Active (recent_active_months >= 1); else Low Activity. - pipeline_health_status: compare current_pipeline_value to total_won_revenue thresholds: >=2× Strong Pipeline; >=1× Healthy Pipeline; >=0.5× Adequate Pipeline; else Weak Pipeline. - Output rows are ordered by overall_performance_score descending.'
      columns:
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales rep identifier; grouping key; exactly one output row per owner_id with total_deals > 0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: owner_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales rep name from owner metrics; passed through from source (may be NULL)
      - name: owner_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sales rep email from owner metrics; passed through from source (may be NULL)
      - name: total_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of deals attributed to the rep from owner metrics; used for filters and activity_level thresholds
      - name: won_deals
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of won deals from owner metrics; used for volume_rank and development_focus
      - name: total_won_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of deal_amount for won deals from owner metrics; basis for revenue_rank, revenue_percentile, and pipeline health thresholds
      - name: win_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Overall win rate percentage (0–100) from owner metrics; used for win_rate_rank and percentiles
      - name: avg_won_cycle_time
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average days to close for won deals from owner metrics; NULL permitted; for ranking, NULL treated as 999
      - name: current_pipeline_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Current open pipeline value from owner metrics (alias of pipeline_value); used for pipeline_health_status thresholds
      - name: enterprise_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Enterprise (100K+) segment win rate in percent; if no decided enterprise deals then 0; computed as 100×won/decided
      - name: large_deal_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Large (50K-100K) segment win rate in percent; if no decided large deals then 0; computed as 100×won/decided
      - name: enterprise_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won deal_amount in Enterprise (100K+) segment; NULL if no territory data joined
      - name: large_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won deal_amount in Large (50K-100K) segment; NULL if no territory data joined
      - name: medium_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won deal_amount in Medium (10K-50K) segment; NULL if no territory data joined
      - name: small_revenue
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of won deal_amount in Small (<10K) segment; NULL if no territory data joined
      - name: revenue_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Integer rank by total_won_revenue descending across all reps; 1 is highest revenue; ties resolved by peer order
      - name: win_rate_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Integer rank by win_rate_percentage descending across all reps; 1 is highest win rate; ties resolved by peer order
      - name: volume_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Integer rank by won_deals descending across all reps; 1 is most wins; ties resolved by peer order
      - name: efficiency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Integer rank by avg_won_cycle_time ascending, treating NULL as 999; 1 is shortest cycle; ties resolved by peer order
      - name: revenue_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile (0–100) using ascending order of total_won_revenue; peers share the same percentile
      - name: win_rate_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile (0–100) using ascending order of win_rate_percentage; peers share the same percentile
      - name: volume_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile (0–100) using ascending order of won_deals; peers share the same percentile
      - name: efficiency_percentile
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentile (0–100) using descending order of avg_won_cycle_time with NULL treated as 999; higher values indicate longer cycles
      - name: overall_performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted sum of percentiles (revenue 40%, win rate 25%, volume 20%, efficiency 15%) scaled by ×100; range 0–10,000
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by overall_performance_score: >=80 Top, >=60 High, >=40 Core, >=20 Developing, else Needs Improvement'
      - name: sales_specialization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_revenue > (large + medium + small), Large Deal Specialist if large_revenue > (enterprise + medium + small), else Generalist if segments_covered >= 3, otherwise Focused Seller
      - name: development_focus
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'First-match guidance: low win rate + long cycle → process; low win rate → improve; very long cycle → accelerate; few wins → increase volume; declining trend → address; else maintain'
      - name: pipeline_health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Pipeline health by current_pipeline_value versus total_won_revenue: >=2x Strong, >=1x Healthy, >=0.5x Adequate, else Weak'
      - name: primary_deal_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most frequent deal_size_category with tie-break by ascending label; NULL if no deal data
      - name: segments_covered
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct deal_size_category values across the rep’s deals; NULL if no deal data
      - name: activity_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Activity classification by recent_active_months and total_deals with ordered thresholds: Highly Active, Active, Moderately Active, or Low Activity'
      - name: activity_consistency
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of monthly_deals_created; higher implies more variability; may be NULL with limited data
      - name: recent_active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of months in the last 3-month window with any monthly activity row (based on created_date); integer >= 0
      - name: performance_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend label from revenue_trend_percentage: >=20 Strong Growth, >=5 Steady Growth, >=-5 Stable, >=-20 Declining, else Significant Decline (NULLs map to else)'
      - name: revenue_trend_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change between recent_6m_avg_revenue and prior_6m_avg_revenue; NULL if prior <= 0 or recent is NULL
      - name: win_rate_trend_points
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Difference in percentage points between recent_6m_avg_win_rate and prior_6m_avg_win_rate; NULL if prior <= 0 or recent is NULL
      - name: revenue_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of monthly_revenue; may be NULL with limited data
      - name: recent_6m_avg_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6; includes months with zero revenue if present; NULL if no months
      - name: prior_6m_avg_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly_revenue where month_index is between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7; NULL if no months
      - name: recent_6m_avg_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly_win_rate (percent) where month_index >= current_month_index - 6; NULL if no months
      - name: prior_6m_avg_win_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average monthly_win_rate (percent) where month_index is between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7; NULL if no months

alternatives.expression_sql: CASE WHEN overall_performance_score >= 80 THEN 'Top Performer' WHEN overall_performance_score >= 60 THEN 'High Performer' WHEN overall_performance_score >= 40 THEN 'Core Performer' WHEN overall_performance_score >= 20 THEN 'Developing Performer' ELSE 'Needs Improvement' END

CASE WHEN enterprise_revenue > COALESCE(large_revenue, 0) + COALESCE(medium_revenue, 0) + COALESCE(small_revenue, 0) THEN 'Enterprise Specialist' WHEN large_revenue > COALESCE(enterprise_revenue, 0) + COALESCE(medium_revenue, 0) + COALESCE(small_revenue, 0) THEN 'Large Deal Specialist' WHEN segments_covered >= 3 THEN 'Generalist' ELSE 'Focused Seller' END

CASE WHEN win_rate_percentage < 15 AND avg_won_cycle_time > 90 THEN 'Focus on Qualification and Process' WHEN win_rate_percentage < 15 THEN 'Improve Win Rate' WHEN avg_won_cycle_time > 120 THEN 'Accelerate Sales Cycle' WHEN won_deals < 5 THEN 'Increase Activity Volume' WHEN revenue_trend_percentage < -5 THEN 'Address Performance Decline' ELSE 'Maintain Current Performance' END

CASE WHEN pipeline_value >= 2 * total_won_revenue THEN 'Strong Pipeline' WHEN pipeline_value >= total_won_revenue THEN 'Healthy Pipeline' WHEN pipeline_value >= 0.5 * total_won_revenue THEN 'Adequate Pipeline' ELSE 'Weak Pipeline' END

CASE WHEN recent_active_months >= 3 AND total_deals >= 10 THEN 'Highly Active' WHEN recent_active_months >= 2 AND total_deals >= 5 THEN 'Active' WHEN recent_active_months >= 1 THEN 'Moderately Active' ELSE 'Low Activity' END

CASE WHEN revenue_trend_percentage >= 20 THEN 'Strong Growth' WHEN revenue_trend_percentage >= 5 THEN 'Steady Growth' WHEN revenue_trend_percentage >= -5 THEN 'Stable' WHEN revenue_trend_percentage >= -20 THEN 'Declining' ELSE 'Significant Decline' END
CASE WHEN t.prior_6m_avg_revenue > 0 THEN 100 * (t.recent_6m_avg_revenue - t.prior_6m_avg_revenue) / t.prior_6m_avg_revenue END
CASE WHEN t.prior_6m_avg_win_rate > 0 THEN t.recent_6m_avg_win_rate - t.prior_6m_avg_win_rate END
AVG(monthly_revenue) FILTER(WHERE month_index BETWEEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) * 12 + MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 12 AND YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) * 12 + MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 7)
AVG(monthly_win_rate) FILTER(WHERE month_index BETWEEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) * 12 + MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 12 AND YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) * 12 + MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 7)

references.name: intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics and retain only owners where total_deals > 0. - Build monthly deal performance per owner from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics: - Group by owner_id and the year/month of created_date; exclude rows where created_date is NULL. - monthly_deals_created: count distinct deal_id per month. - monthly_deals_won: count distinct deal_id where deal_status = ''Won''. - monthly_revenue: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Won'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_pipeline_added: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Open'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_win_rate: if decided deals (Won or Lost) exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - monthly_avg_cycle_time: average deal_cycle_time_days for won deals; NULL if none. - Aggregate per-owner trends over monthly data: - Use month_index = performance_year*12 + performance_month and current_month_index from current_date. - recent_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6 (inclusive). - prior_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7 (inclusive). - recent_6m_avg_win_rate / prior_6m_avg_win_rate: analogous averages over monthly_win_rate (percent values). - revenue_volatility: standard deviation of monthly_revenue; very long cycle → Accelerate Sales Cycle; few wins → Increase Activity Volume; declining revenue trend → Address Performance Decline; else Maintain Current Performance. - activity_level (first-match): Highly Active (recent_active_months >= 3 and total_deals >= 10); business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics and retain only owners where total_deals > 0. - Build monthly deal performance per owner from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics: - Group by owner_id and the year/month of created_date; exclude rows where created_date is NULL. - monthly_deals_created: count distinct deal_id per month. - monthly_deals_won: count distinct deal_id where deal_status = ''Won''. - monthly_revenue: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Won'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_pipeline_added: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Open'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_win_rate: if decided deals (Won or Lost) exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - monthly_avg_cycle_time: average deal_cycle_time_days for won deals; NULL if none. - Aggregate per-owner trends over monthly data: - Use month_index = performance_year*12 + performance_month and current_month_index from current_date. - recent_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6 (inclusive). - prior_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7 (inclusive). - recent_6m_avg_win_rate / prior_6m_avg_win_rate: analogous averages over monthly_win_rate (percent values). - revenue_volatility: standard deviation of monthly_revenue; activity_consistency: standard deviation of monthly_deals_created. - recent_active_months: count of monthly rows in the last 3 calendar months (relative to current_date), inclusive. - Territory and segment analysis per owner from all deals: - primary_deal_segment: most frequent deal_size_category; ties break by ascending category label. - segments_covered: count distinct deal_size_category. - enterprise/large/medium/small_revenue: sum won deal_amount within each named deal_size_category. - enterprise_win_rate / large_deal_win_rate: if decided deals in the segment exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - Rankings and percentiles from owner metrics: - revenue_rank: best-to-worst by total_won_revenue; win_rate_rank: best-to-worst by win_rate_percentage; volume_rank: best-to-worst by won_deals. - efficiency_rank: best-to-worst by avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999. - revenue_percentile / win_rate_percentile / volume_percentile: percentile position (0–100) across all reps using ascending order of each metric; peers share the same percentile. - efficiency_percentile: percentile position (0–100) using descending order of avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999 (longer cycles → higher percentile). - overall_performance_score: weighted sum of these percentiles (revenue 40%, win rate 25%, volume 20%, efficiency 15%), then scaled by ×100 to a 0–10,000 range. - Ties in ranks are resolved by the database’s implicit peer order. - Join rankings to trends and territory by owner_id (cast trend/territory owner_id to VARCHAR); unmatched trend/territory values remain NULL. - Derivations: - revenue_trend_percentage: if prior_6m_avg_revenue > 0 and recent_6m_avg_revenue is not NULL, compute 100 × (recent - prior) / prior; else NULL. - win_rate_trend_points: if prior_6m_avg_win_rate > 0 and recent_6m_avg_win_rate is not NULL, compute recent - prior; else NULL. - performance_tier: >=80 Top Performer; >=60 High Performer; >=40 Core Performer; >=20 Developing Performer; else Needs Improvement. - performance_trend: >=20 Strong Growth; >=5 Steady Growth; >=-5 Stable; >=-20 Declining; else Significant Decline (NULLs map to the else). - sales_specialization: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_revenue strictly exceeds (large + medium + small); Large Deal Specialist if large_revenue strictly exceeds (enterprise + medium + small); else if segments_covered >= 3 then Generalist; otherwise Focused Seller. - development_focus (first-match order): low win rate + long cycle → Focus on Qualification and Process; low win rate → Improve Win Rate; very long cycle → Accelerate Sales Cycle; few wins → Increase Activity Volume; declining revenue trend → Address Performance Decline; else Maintain Current Performance. - activity_level (first-match): Highly Active (recent_active_months >= 3 and total_deals >= 10); Active (recent_active_months >= 2 and total_deals >= 5); Moderately Active (recent_active_months >= 1); else Low Activity. - pipeline_health_status: compare current_pipeline_value to total_won_revenue thresholds: >=2× Strong Pipeline; >=1× Healthy Pipeline; >=0.5× Adequate Pipeline; else Weak Pipeline. - Output rows are ordered by overall_performance_score descending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: hubspot__customer_support_analytics
      schema: service
      description: Customer support analytics with SLA compliance, urgency scoring, and risk/service classifications; timestamps are set at execution time.
      grain: Rows per ticket_id; duplicates may occur due to left joins to contact/company mappings (no de-duplication).
      source_models:
      - raw.ticket_data
      - raw.ticket_contact_data
      - staging.stg_hubspot__contact
      - raw.ticket_company_data
      - raw.company_data
      - raw.owner_data
      business_logic: '- Start from raw.ticket_data t and keep tickets where t.is_deleted != ''true''. - Set created_date = current_timestamp (execution time); set closed_date = current_timestamp only if t.property_closed_date is not null and not empty, else NULL. - Derive resolution_time_hours: 24 if t.property_closed_date is not null, else 8. - Derive ticket_status: ''Closed'' if t.property_closed_date is not null; else if t.property_hs_pipeline_stage LIKE ''%waiting%'' then ''Waiting for Customer''; else if LIKE ''%progress%'' then ''In Progress''; else ''Open''. - Derive priority_level from t.property_hs_ticket_priority: 1→High, 2→Medium, 3→Low, others→Medium. - Derive sla_target_hours by priority_level: High→4, Medium→24, Low→48, default→24. - Enrich using left joins: - Join raw.ticket_contact_data tc on cast(regexp_extract(t.id, ''ID(\d+)'', 1) as bigint) = tc.ticket_id; then staging.stg_hubspot__contact c on cast(tc.contact_id as varchar) = c.contact_id. - Join raw.ticket_company_data tco on cast(regexp_extract(t.id, ''ID(\d+)'', 1) as bigint) = tco.ticket_id; then raw.company_data comp on tco.company_id = comp.id. - Join raw.owner_data o on t.property_hubspot_owner_id = o.owner_id. - Left joins may introduce duplicate rows per ticket_id; no de-duplication is applied. - Derive SLA performance: - sla_status: ''Met SLA'' if resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours; ''Near Miss'' if <= 1.5 × sla_target_hours; else ''SLA Breach''. - sla_breach_hours: 0 if resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours; else resolution_time_hours − sla_target_hours. - Derive urgency_score as integer sum of three components: - Priority weight: High 40, Medium 20, else 10. - Revenue weight: ≥1,000,000 → 30; ≥100,000 → 20; >0 → 10; else 5. - Resolution-time weight: ≥72 → 30; ≥24 → 20; ≥4 → 10; else 0. - Derive resolution_efficiency: - If ticket_status=''Closed'' and resolution_time_hours <= 0.5 × sla_target_hours → ''Fast Resolution''. - Else if ''Closed'' and resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours → ''Standard Resolution''. - Else if ''Closed'' → ''Slow Resolution''. - Else → ''Unresolved''. - Final derivations: - customer_segment from company_annual_revenue: ≥1,000,000 → ''Enterprise Customer''; ≥100,000 → ''Mid-Market Customer''; >0 → ''SMB Customer''; else ''Unknown Size''. - escalation_recommendation from urgency_score: ≥80 → ''Critical - Immediate Escalation''; ≥60 → ''High - Manager Review''; ≥40 → ''Medium - Monitor Closely''; else ''Low - Standard Process''. - service_quality_rating: ''Excellent Service'' if resolution_efficiency=''Fast Resolution'' and sla_status=''Met SLA''; ''Good Service'' if resolution_efficiency∈{''Fast Resolution'',''Standard Resolution''} and sla_status=''Met SLA''; ''Adequate Service'' if sla_status=''Near Miss''; else ''Poor Service''. - days_open: if ticket_status!=''Closed'' then days between created_date and current_date; else NULL. - risk_level (only for non-closed): if urgency_score≥70 and days_open≥3 → ''High Risk''; else if urgency_score≥50 and days_open≥7 → ''Medium Risk''; else if days_open≥14 → ''Low Risk''; else ''No Risk''; closed tickets return ''No Risk''. - Output columns exactly as selected; results are ordered by urgency_score desc, then created_date desc.'
      columns:
      - name: ticket_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: HubSpot ticket identifier from raw.ticket_data.id; may repeat due to left joins; non-null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ticket_subject
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ticket subject from raw.ticket_data.property_subject; NULLs preserved.
      - name: ticket_pipeline
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline name from raw.ticket_data.property_hs_pipeline; NULLs preserved.
      - name: ticket_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline stage from raw.ticket_data.property_hs_pipeline_stage; NULLs preserved.
      - name: ticket_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived: ''Closed'' if source closed_date is not null; else ''Waiting for Customer'' if stage contains ''waiting''; ''In Progress'' if stage contains ''progress''; else ''Open''.'
      - name: priority_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from property_hs_ticket_priority: 1→High, 2→Medium, 3→Low, others→Medium.'
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution-time timestamp set to current_timestamp; always non-null.
      - name: closed_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution-time timestamp set to current_timestamp only when source closed_date is present and not empty; else NULL.
      - name: days_open
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: For non-closed tickets, days from created_date to current_date at execution time; else NULL.
      - name: resolution_time_hours
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Fixed: 24 if source closed_date is present, else 8.'
      - name: sla_target_hours
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Target by priority: High 4, Medium 24, Low 48, default 24.'
      - name: sla_breach_hours
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 0 if resolution_time_hours ≤ sla_target_hours; otherwise the positive difference.
      - name: sla_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'SLA result: ''Met SLA'' if within target; ''Near Miss'' if within 1.5× target; else ''SLA Breach''.'
      - name: resolution_efficiency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Closed & time ≤ 0.5× target → Fast; Closed & time ≤ target → Standard; Closed → Slow; otherwise Unresolved.
      - name: urgency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Sum of weights: priority (High 40/Medium 20/else 10) + revenue (≥1M 30/≥100k 20/>0 10/else 5) + time (≥72 30/≥24 20/≥4 10/else 0).'
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'For non-closed: ≥70 urgency and ≥3 days → High; ≥50 and ≥7 days → Medium; ≥14 days → Low; else No Risk; closed return No Risk.'
      - name: service_quality_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Excellent if Fast Resolution and Met SLA; Good if (Fast or Standard) and Met SLA; Adequate if Near Miss; else Poor.
      - name: escalation_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on urgency_score: ≥80 Critical; ≥60 High; ≥40 Medium; else Low.'
      - name: agent_first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner first name from raw.owner_data via owner_id; NULLs preserved.
      - name: agent_last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner last name from raw.owner_data via owner_id; NULLs preserved.
      - name: agent_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner email from raw.owner_data via owner_id; NULLs preserved.
      - name: contact_first_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact first name from staging.stg_hubspot__contact via ticket_contact mapping; NULLs preserved.
      - name: contact_last_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact last name from staging.stg_hubspot__contact via ticket_contact mapping; NULLs preserved.
      - name: contact_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact email from staging.stg_hubspot__contact via ticket_contact mapping; NULLs preserved.
      - name: contact_job_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact job title from staging.stg_hubspot__contact via ticket_contact mapping; NULLs preserved.
      - name: company_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company name from raw.company_data via ticket_company mapping; NULLs preserved.
      - name: company_industry
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Company industry from raw.company_data via ticket_company mapping; NULLs preserved.
      - name: company_annual_revenue
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Company annual revenue from raw.company_data.property_annualrevenue; integer units; NULLs preserved.
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'From company_annual_revenue: ≥1,000,000 Enterprise; ≥100,000 Mid-Market; >0 SMB; else Unknown Size.'

CASE WHEN t.property_hs_ticket_priority = 1 THEN 'High' WHEN t.property_hs_ticket_priority = 3 THEN 'Low' ELSE 'Medium' END
CASE WHEN NOT t.property_closed_date IS NULL AND t.property_closed_date <> '' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END
CASE WHEN ticket_status <> 'Closed' THEN CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(created_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT) END
CASE WHEN NOT t.property_closed_date IS NULL THEN 24 ELSE 8 END

CASE WHEN resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours THEN 0 ELSE resolution_time_hours - sla_target_hours END
CASE WHEN resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours THEN 'Met SLA' WHEN resolution_time_hours <= 1.5 * sla_target_hours THEN 'Near Miss' ELSE 'SLA Breach' END

CASE WHEN ticket_status = 'Closed' AND resolution_time_hours <= 0.5 * sla_target_hours THEN 'Fast Resolution' WHEN ticket_status = 'Closed' AND resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours THEN 'Standard Resolution' WHEN ticket_status = 'Closed' THEN 'Slow Resolution' ELSE 'Unresolved' END

references.name: raw.ticket_data
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Start from raw.ticket_data t and keep tickets where t.is_deleted != ''true''. - Set created_date = current_timestamp (execution time); set closed_date = current_timestamp only if t.property_closed_date is not null and not empty, else NULL. - Derive resolution_time_hours: 24 if t.property_closed_date is not null, else 8. - Derive ticket_status: ''Closed'' if t.property_closed_date is not null; else if t.property_hs_pipeline_stage LIKE ''%waiting%'' then ''Waiting for Customer''; else if LIKE ''%progress%'' then ''In Progress''; else ''Open''. - Derive priority_level from t.property_hs_ticket_priority: 1→High, 2→Medium, 3→Low, others→Medium. - Derive sla_target_hours by priority_level: High→4, Medium→24, Low→48, default→24. - Enrich using left joins: - Join raw.ticket_contact_data tc on cast(regexp_extract(t.id, ''ID(\d+)'', 1) as bigint) = tc.ticket_id; then staging.stg_hubspot__contact c on cast(tc.contact_id as varchar) = c.contact_id. - Join raw.ticket_company_data tco on cast(regexp_extract(t.id, ''ID(\d+)'', 1) as bigint) = tco.ticket_id; then raw.company_data comp on tco.company_id = comp.id. - Join raw.owner_data o on t.property_hubspot_owner_id = o.owner_id. - Left joins may introduce duplicate rows per ticket_id; no de-duplication is applied. - Derive SLA performance: - sla_status: ''Met SLA'' if resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours; ''Near Miss'' if <= 1.5 × sla_target_hours; else ''SLA Breach''. - sla_breach_hours: 0 if resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours; else resolution_time_hours − sla_target_hours. - Derive urgency_score as integer sum of three components: - Priority weight: High 40, Medium 20, else 10. - Revenue weight: ≥1,000,000 → 30; ≥100,000 → 20; >0 → 10; else 5. - Resolution-time weight: ≥72 → 30; ≥24 → 20; ≥4 → 10; else 0. - Derive resolution_efficiency: - If ticket_status=''Closed'' and resolution_time_hours <= 0.5 × sla_target_hours → ''Fast Resolution''. - Else if ''Closed'' and resolution_time_hours <= sla_target_hours → ''Standard Resolution''. - Else if ''Closed'' → ''Slow Resolution''. - Else → ''Unresolved''. - Final derivations: - customer_segment from company_annual_revenue: ≥1,000,000 → ''Enterprise Customer''; ≥100,000 → ''Mid-Market Customer''; >0 → ''SMB Customer''; else ''Unknown Size''. - escalation_recommendation from urgency_score: ≥80 → ''Critical - Immediate Escalation''; ≥60 → ''High - Manager Review''; ≥40 → ''Medium - Monitor Closely''; else ''Low - Standard Process''. - service_quality_rating: ''Excellent Service'' if resolution_efficiency=''Fast Resolution'' and sla_status=''Met SLA''; ''Good Service'' if resolution_efficiency∈{''Fast Resolution'',''Standard Resolution''} and sla_status=''Met SLA''; ''Adequate Service'' if sla_status=''Near Miss''; else ''Poor Service''. - days_open: if ticket_status!=''Closed'' then days between created_date and current_date; else NULL. - risk_level (only for non-closed): if urgency_score≥70 and days_open≥3 → ''High Risk''; else if urgency_score≥50 and days_open≥7 → ''Medium Risk''; else if days_open≥14 → ''Low Risk''; else ''No Risk''; closed tickets return ''No Risk''. - Output columns exactly as selected; results are ordered by urgency_score desc, then created_date desc.'

count(case when spm.created_date >= current_date - interval '7 days' then 1 end) as tickets_last_7_days

when spm.ticket_status != 'Closed' and spm.urgency_score >= 50 and datediff('day', spm.created_date, current_date) >= 7 then 'Medium Risk'

blocks.original_text:
- name: hubspot__tickets
      schema: service
      description: Comprehensive HubSpot ticket facts enriched with pipeline/stage attributes, owner details, and aggregated company/contact associations
      grain: One row per ticket_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_hubspot__ticket
      - staging.stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline
      - staging.stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline_stage
      - staging.stg_hubspot__ticket_company
      - staging.stg_hubspot__company
      - staging.stg_hubspot__ticket_contact
      - staging.stg_hubspot__contact
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__owners_enhanced
      business_logic: '- Load all tickets; output grain is one row per ticket_id. - Left join pipeline attributes on ticket_pipeline_id. - Left join stage attributes on ticket_pipeline_stage_id, and require the stage’s pipeline_id to match the ticket’s pipeline_id. - Left join owner details on owner_id. - Company associations: - Left join ticket_company to company to bring company_name. - Per ticket_id, concatenate company_id values with "," and separately concatenate company_name values with ",". - NULL inputs become empty elements in the concatenation; duplicates are kept; no ordering is imposed; if no company rows exist, the concatenated fields are NULL. - Contact associations: - Left join ticket_contact to contact to bring email. - Per ticket_id, concatenate contact_id values with "," and separately concatenate email values with ",". - NULL inputs become empty elements in the concatenation; duplicates are kept; no ordering is imposed; if no contact rows exist, the concatenated fields are NULL. - Select all ticket fields plus joined attributes and aggregations; no additional filtering or de-duplication.'
      columns:
      - name: ticket_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key of the ticket; exactly one output row per ticket_id (from stg_hubspot__ticket)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: owner_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner identifier from stg_hubspot__ticket; used to join owner details; NULL preserved
      - name: ticket_subject
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ticket subject/title from stg_hubspot__ticket; NULL preserved
      - name: ticket_content
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ticket body/description from stg_hubspot__ticket; NULL preserved
      - name: ticket_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ticket category from stg_hubspot__ticket; NULL preserved
      - name: ticket_priority
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Numeric priority value from stg_hubspot__ticket; NULL preserved
      - name: ticket_pipeline_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline identifier from stg_hubspot__ticket; used to join pipeline metadata; NULL preserved
      - name: ticket_pipeline_stage_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage identifier from stg_hubspot__ticket; used to join stage metadata; NULL preserved
      - name: created_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Ticket creation timestamp from stg_hubspot__ticket; timezone-naive; NULL preserved
      - name: closed_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Ticket closed timestamp from stg_hubspot__ticket; timezone-naive; NULL preserved
      - name: first_agent_reply_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First agent reply timestamp from stg_hubspot__ticket; timezone-naive; NULL preserved
      - name: is_ticket_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Ticket deletion flag from stg_hubspot__ticket; NULL preserved
      - name: _fivetran_synced
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Last Fivetran sync timestamp from stg_hubspot__ticket; timezone-aware; NULL preserved
      - name: ticket_state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage state from stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline_stage joined by stage_id and matching pipeline_id; NULL if no match
      - name: company_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated company_id values per ticket; NULL inputs become empty elements; duplicates kept; order not guaranteed; NULL when no associated companies
      - name: contact_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated contact_id values per ticket; NULL inputs become empty elements; duplicates kept; order not guaranteed; NULL when no associated contacts
      - name: contact_emails
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated contact emails per ticket; NULL inputs become empty elements; duplicates kept; order not guaranteed; NULL when no associated contacts
      - name: owner_active_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Active user identifier from int_hubspot__owners_enhanced joined by owner_id; NULL if no match
      - name: company_names
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated company names per ticket; NULL inputs become empty elements; duplicates kept; order not guaranteed; NULL when no associated companies
      - name: owner_email_address
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner email address from int_hubspot__owners_enhanced joined by owner_id; NULL if no match
      - name: pipeline_stage_label
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage label from stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline_stage joined by stage_id and matching pipeline_id; NULL if no match
      - name: is_ticket_pipeline_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Pipeline deletion flag from stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline joined by pipeline_id; NULL if no match
      - name: is_ticket_pipeline_stage_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Stage deletion flag from stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline_stage joined by stage_id and matching pipeline_id; NULL if no match
      - name: is_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Stage closed flag from stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline_stage joined by stage_id and matching pipeline_id; NULL if no match
      - name: pipeline_stage_order
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stage display order from stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline_stage joined by stage_id and matching pipeline_id; NULL if no match
      - name: pipeline_label
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pipeline label from stg_hubspot__ticket_pipeline joined by pipeline_id; NULL if no match
      - name: owner_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Owner full name from int_hubspot__owners_enhanced joined by owner_id; NULL if no match

blocks.original_text:
- name: stg_hubspot__company
      description: "Cleaned company records with validated revenue data and standardized industry classifications"
      source_table: raw.company_data
      columns:
        - name: company_id
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: company_name
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: description
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: industry
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "industry IS NULL OR industry IN ('Technology','Healthcare','Finance','Manufacturing','Retail','Education','Government','Other','Consulting','Real Estate','Hospitality')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: address
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: address_2
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: city
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: state
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: country
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: annual_revenue
          data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "annual_revenue IS NULL OR annual_revenue >= 0"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "annual_revenue IS NULL OR annual_revenue <= 9999999999999.99"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "CASE WHEN annual_revenue IS NOT NULL AND annual_revenue > 0 THEN annual_revenue BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999999999999.99 ELSE TRUE END"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: created_date
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "created_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "created_date >= '2000-01-01'"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: is_company_deleted
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "is_company_deleted IN (TRUE, FALSE)"
